lo: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.

gt: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
lo: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

gt: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [WRAITH] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

gt: For each other [SAURON] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
lo: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

gt: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lo: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

gt: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lo: “‘Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues....'”

gt: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.
Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish that involves a [SAURON] Orc, each [SAURON] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.

gt: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [SAURON] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lo: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.

gt: Response: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.
lo: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

gt: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).
lo: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.

gt: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lo: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight – and the spoils of victory.

gt: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
lo: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

gt: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).
lo: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.

gt: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
lo: The cunning Ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.

gt: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lo: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.

gt: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
lo: Sauron has countless armies of Orcs at his disposal.

gt: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc kills a companion, add 1 burden (or 3 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
lo: “The Ring that hung upon its chain about his neck grew heavy, heavier than a great stone, and his head was dragged downwards.”

gt: To play, exert [SAURON] a Orc. Plays to your support area. While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lo: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.

gt: Search. Plays to your support area. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert a [SAURON] tracker to cancel that event.
lo: “‘...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and remove (2) to draw a card.
lo: “‘This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'”

gt: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lo: “‘Is it secret? Is it safe?'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +1.
lo: Fear of death in Barad-dûr's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).
lo: “‘I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'”

gt: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
lo: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

gt: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] tracker. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
lo: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on Aragorn.
lo: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

gt: To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion (except an Elf). While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.
lo: “‘And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to shuffle a [SHIRE] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: “‘...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.

gt: Skirmish: Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
lo: “‘Aye, reckon we're in for a quiet night... mind how you go.'”

gt: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.
lo: “‘Don't despair!' said Strider. ‘You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.
lo: “‘Old Maggot is really a stout fellow – if you leave his mushrooms alone.'”

gt: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). At the start of each of your turns, you may heal a Hobbit ally.
lo: “‘But be that as it may, Mr. Frodo is as nice a young hobbit as you could wish to meet.'”

gt: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Exert another companion who has the Frodo signet to heal Frodo.
lo: “‘I think you'll find there's more to this Hobbit than meets the eye.'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.
lo: “No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove (X).
lo: “‘This... is the one art that we certainly claim to be our own invention. When Hobbits first began to smoke is not known....'”

gt: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit to make him strength +3.
lo: “...though they are inclined to be fat and do not hurry unnecessarily, they are nonetheless nimble and deft in their movements.”

gt: Fellowship: Add (X) to heal a Hobbit companion X times.
lo: “‘What about Elevenses, Luncheon, Afternoon Tea and Supper – he knows about them, doesn't he?'”

gt: While you can spot your site 1, this ally has the game text of that site. Fellowship: Exert this ally and spot opponent's site 1 to replace it with your site 1.
lo: “‘...where our hearts truly lie is in peace and quiet and good-tilled earth....'”

gt: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 4, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +3.
lo: “‘What? That were just a little detour, that's all... a shortcut.'”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, heal this ally. Fellowship: Exert this ally to heal another Hobbit ally whose home is site 1.
lo: “‘More promising still (to the hobbits' mind): an enourmous open-air kitchen was erected....'”

gt: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 5, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +2.
lo: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by....”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
lo: “‘Strap these on....'”

gt: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand.
lo: Longbottom Leaf is the pipeweed enjoyed by most Hobbits throughout the Shire.

gt: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add (2) to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all [SHIRE] cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
lo: “His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....”

gt: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him twice to add his strength to another companion.
lo: “‘We're coming too! You'll have to send us home tied up in a sack to stop us!'”

gt: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
lo: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

gt: Skirmish: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lo: “‘You carry the fate of us all, little one.... If this is indeed the will of the Council, then Gondor will see it done.'”

gt: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lo: Bilbo's favorite pipeweed is Old Toby, the finest weed in the Southfarthing.

gt: Your opponent may not discard your [SHIRE] tales from play.
lo: “‘Baggins? Sure I know a Baggins – Frodo's my second cousin once-removed, on his mother's side and my third cousin twice-removed on his father's side, if you follow me.'”

gt: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or wound from a companion.
lo: “‘Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'”

gt: Skirmish: Add 1 burden to wound each minion skirmishing the Ring-bearer.
lo: “‘The ring had given him power according to his stature.'”

gt: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie Cotton to heal Sam.
lo: “‘Go on Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.'”

gt: Fellowship: Play Bill the Pony from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Sam to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.
lo: “‘I am sorry that I brought this upon you... sorry you must carry this burden.'”

gt: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (4)).
lo: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

gt: Tale. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character. Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.
lo: ‘“For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins, / ‘I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'”

gt: Maneuver or Skirmish: Heal a Hobbit.
lo: “‘You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'”

t: A Talent for Not Being Seen
gt: Stealth. To play, exert a Hobbit. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the shadow number -1 (or spot 4 to make it -2).
lo: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

gt: Tale. Bearer must be a Hobbit companion. Maneuver: Discard this condition to make each Hobbit companion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘So there I was – at the mercy of three monstrous trolls....'”

lo: “...his long white hair, his sweeping silver beard, and his broad shoulders, made him look like some wise king of ancient legend.”

gt: Ranger. At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another companion who has the Aragorn signet.
lo: “‘He turned from that path a long time ago. He has chosen exile....'”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to play a [DWARVEN] weapon from your discard pile.
lo: “‘There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; / The delver mined, the mason built.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf defender +1 (or defender +2 if you spot an Orc) until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Ah, alas!...When will the day come of our revenge?'”

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, discard this possession to prevent that wound.
lo: Dwarven-smiths forge bracers for fit and agility.

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +1.
lo: “‘Dwarves too can go swiftly, and they do not tire sooner than Orcs.'”

gt: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if bearing 2 hand weapons).
lo: With a second axe, a warrior of Erebor can parry on either flank and counter quickly.

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Fror is strength +3.
lo: “It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.”

gt: For each [DWARVEN] tale you can spot, Gloin is strength +1 (limit +4).
lo: “‘But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'”

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. Plays to your support area. At a site which is not underground, each [MORIA] Orc's twilight cost is +2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lo: “‘The Orcs will not, maybe, come out till after dusk, but we must be far away before nightfall.'”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Dwarf, you may discard the top 2 cards from your draw deck to take a [DWARVEN] event into hand from your discard pile.
lo: “‘Moria! Moria!... Long have its vast mansions lain empty since the children of Durin fled.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Archery: Discard this weapon to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lo: Their captain rallied two other orcs to attack. In answer, Gimli's side axe brought him down.

gt: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion and discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to discard either a Shadow condition from a Dwarf or a weather condition.
lo: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

gt: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3).
lo: “‘There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'”

gt: Regroup: Spot a Dwarf to draw 3 cards. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lo: “‘...we have so far been fortunate, though we do not escape the shadow of these times.'”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf companion moves from an underground site, you may heal that Dwarf.
lo: “Gimli was silent. Having sung his song, he would say no more.”

gt: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to make an opponent draw 2 cards. That player then chooses to either discard 2 Shadow cards from hand or skip his or her next Shadow phase.
To play, spot an Elf. Plays to your support area. Each Uruk-hai is strength -2 and loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lo: “‘...he has been doing something to them.... For these Isengarders are more like wicked Men.'”

gt: Response: If an Elf archer wins a skirmish, make an opponent choose a minion to discard. That opponent may remove (3) to prevent this.
lo: Reeling from the bite of an arrow, the Cave Troll became enraged trying to strike the nimble Elf.

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Elf companion, the minion archery total is -1. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘...many great princes and captains were assembled.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound each Nazgul once (or twice if at a river).
lo: “The three Riders that were still in the midst of the Ford were overwhelmed.... Their piercing cries were drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them away.”

gt: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (or 2 conditions if you spot an Orc).
lo: “‘Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'”

gt: To play, spot Gandalf. Shadow players may not look at or reveal cards in your hand.
lo: “‘They are good folk the Bardings. The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard.'”

gt: Bearer must be Gandalf. The twilight cost of each [GANDALF] spell is -1. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf twice to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lo: “As the wizard passed on ahead up the great steps, he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a faint radiance.”

gt: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each possession or artifact played on Gandalf or a character who has the Gandalf signet is -1.
lo: “Now as the companions sat or walked together they spoke of Gandalf, and all that each had known and seen of him came clear before their minds.”

gt: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Hugin to reveal a Free Peoples card from your discard pile and place it beneath your draw deck.
lo: Several wise Bardings were sent to Elrond to tell of the Dark Lord's new offer.

gt: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time you play a shield, armor, helm, or hand weapon, its twilight cost is -1.
lo: The Men of Dale freely traded with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain for fine metalwork.

gt: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Gandalf to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). Draw a card if you play an underground site.
lo: “Picking up his staff he stood before the rock and said in a clear voice: Mellon!”

gt: Spell. Skirmish: Discard a staff Gandalf is bearing and then exert him twice to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lo: “At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.”

gt: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to make a companion defender +1 until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lo: “The Balrog made no answer. The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.”

gt: Bearer must be a Wizard. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.
lo: “‘We must have power – power to order things as we will for that Good which only the Wise can see.'”

gt: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf bearing a staff to prevent a minion from being fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “The Balrog fell back and its sword flew up in molten fragments. The wizard swayed on the bridge, stepped back a pace, and then again stood still.”

gt: To play, exert a [GONDOR] companion. Plays to your support area. Each [SAURON] Orc comes into play exhausted. Skip the archery phase. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lo: “‘I do not know what strength is in my blood, but I swear to you – I will not let the White City fall....'”

gt: Bearer must be a Man. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Bearer is strength +2 and damage +1 while skirmishing a Nazgul.
lo: “...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.”

gt: Response: If a [GONDOR] companion wins a skirmish, discard an exhausted Orc. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
lo: “Aragorn smote to the ground the captain that stood in his path, and the rest fled in terror of his wrath.”

gt: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, exert a [GONDOR] companion to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘Boromir!... Go after those two young hobbits, and guard them at the least, even if you cannot find Frodo.'”

gt: To play, spot a ranger. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at a forest, the minion archery total is -2.
lo: The tree, the bough, the leaf. To a ranger, these are all defenses against the enemy.

gt: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make another companion strength +2 (or +3 if that companion has the Aragorn signet).
lo: “‘If by my life or death, I can protect you, I will....'”

gt: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +4 if in a fierce skirmish).
lo: “...they still preserved through the suns and rains of forgotten years the mighty likenesses in which they had been hewn.”

gt: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.
lo: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.

gt: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard an armor possession, helm possession, or shield possession (or all such Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions).
lo: “‘Whom do you serve?'”

gt: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a [SHIRE] ally exerts, add (1).
lo: “In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville-Bagginses arrived.”

gt: Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai and spot X burdens to shuffle X minions from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: “‘It is not the Eastern Shore I am worried about. A shadow and a threat has been growing in my mind. Something draws near, I can feel it.'”

gt: Discard this minion if underground. Shadow: Exert this minion to look at the Free Peoples player's hand.
lo: “‘He looks more than half like a goblin.'”

gt: Bearer must be Lurtz. He is damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lo: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.

gt: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.
lo: “‘Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'”

gt: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [ISENGARD] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 5 cards of his or her draw deck.
lo: “‘A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'”

gt: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Uruk Captain to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.
lo: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.

gt: Tracker. Damage +1. The roaming penalty for each [ISENGARD] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lo: Forward Uruk troops caught the fellowship unaware.

gt: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. When the fellowship moves from this site, every companion must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lo: “There was a black look in the sky, and the sun was wan. The wind had gone now round to the north-east.”

gt: Archer. Each other [MORIA] archer is strength +2.
lo: Their commander led the Goblin bowmen to the highest rise across the gap.

gt: Bearer must be The Balrog. It is damage +1. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lo: “In its right hand was a blade like a stabbing tongue of fire....”

gt: Damage +1. Fierce. While you can spot The Balrog, discard all other minions. Skip the archery phase. Discard The Balrog if not underground.
lo: “‘Indeed I saw upon the bridge that which haunts our darkest dreams....'”

gt: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Discard The Balrog if not underground. Shadow: Exert The Balrog and remove (2) to play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
lo: “...suddenly it drew itself up to a great height, and its wings were spread from wall to wall....”

gt: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. The Free Peoples player may choose for the archery phase to be skipped. Each time Cave Troll of Moria takes a wound during the archery phase, you may wound an archer companion.
lo: “‘They have a Cave Troll!'”

gt: To play, spot The Balrog. Plays on Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves, Gandalf must exert.
lo: “...he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm.”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each unique [MORIA] minion is strength +1. Shadow: Spot an opponent's site to replace it with your marsh or underground site of the same number.
lo: “‘There is some new devilry here... devised for our welcome, no doubt.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. While you can spot The Balrog, skip the archery phase. Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to discard a ranged weapon.
lo: “He drew, but his hand fell, and the arrow slipped to the ground. He gave a cry of dismay and fear.”

gt: Response: If a skirmish that involved The Balrog bearing Whip of Many Thongs is about to end, wound a companion in that skirmish twice.
lo: “...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about the wizard's knees, dragging him to the brink.”

gt: Tentacle. When you play this minion, you may play a tentacle from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lo: “Its fingered end had hold of Frodo's foot, and was dragging him into the water.”

gt: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] minion from your discard pile.
lo: “‘Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'”

gt: Archer.
lo: The crude arrows of the Goblins served notice of the dangers of Moria.

gt: When you play this minion, you may add (3) if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn.
lo: “‘There are Orcs, very many of them.... And some are large and evil....'”

gt: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, this minion is strength +3.
lo: Had the fellowship remained in Dimrill Dale, pursuers from Moria would have overwhelmed them.

gt: When you play this minion, you may heal a [MORIA] minion.
lo: “‘We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'”

gt: When you play this minion, you may discard an [ELVEN] condition. The roaming penalty for each [MORIA] Orc you play is -1.
lo: “Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.”

gt: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.
lo: “...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....”

gt: Tentacle. Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lo: “Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.”

gt: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lo: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!

gt: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.
lo: “His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.”

gt: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [MORIA] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).
lo: “‘I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'”

gt: Shadow: Reveal any number of [MORIA] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.
lo: “The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.”

gt: To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion. Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.
lo: “‘This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking-party....Now be quiet!'”

gt: Shadow: Exert a [MORIA] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).
lo: “‘The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke....There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'”

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles). Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lo: “The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.”

gt: Bearer must be The Balrog. Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.
lo: “It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.”

gt: Nazgul are not roaming. The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
lo: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

gt: To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgul. Plays on Sam. Sam's game text does not apply.
lo: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

gt: Plays to your support area. Response: If a twilight Nazgul is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'”

gt: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgul to add a burden.
lo: “...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.”

gt: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgul to exert the Ring-bearer. If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lo: “Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.”

gt: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.
lo: “He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.”

gt: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgul and spot X burdens to exert X companions.
lo: “...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.”

gt: Twilight. When you play Ulaire Attea, you may wound an ally.
lo: “‘They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'”

gt: Twilight. Each time Ulaire Enquea wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you spot 5 burdens).
lo: “In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....”

gt: Twilight. While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Ulaire Nelya is fierce and damage +1.
lo: “Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather than saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.”

gt: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
lo: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

gt: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgul and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.
lo: “‘He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'”

gt: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
lo: “‘...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [ELVEN] allies).
lo: “‘But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'”

gt: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
lo: “‘Orc!...Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'”

gt: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lo: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

gt: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
lo: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

gt: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you spot a [SAURON] tracker).
lo: “‘Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
lo: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
lo: “There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.”

gt: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
lo: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commander's blade.

gt: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.
lo: “...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.”

gt: Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo. Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).
lo: “‘He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
lo: “He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.”

gt: Stealth. Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.
lo: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.”

gt: Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.
lo: “‘Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'”

gt: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
lo: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.

gt: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The cost of each artifact, possession, and [SHIRE] tale played on Frodo is -1.
lo: “‘I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert a Hobbit bearing a weapon to wound a minion. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
lo: Boromir sensed that a blade in a Halfling's hand would surprise a larger foe.

gt: Fellowship: Exert Merry to play Farmer Maggot from your draw deck.
lo: “‘Ow... I think I've broken somehing.'”

gt: Bearer must be Frodo. The minion archery total is -1. Each minion skirmishing Frodo does not gain strength bonuses from weapons and loses all damage bonuses.
lo: “‘...its worth was greater than the value of the whole Shire and everything in it.'”

gt: Stealth. Plays to your support area. Response: If a Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘Very life-like!... But what will happen when they have penetrated the disguise?'”

gt: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. Each Nazgul is strength -4. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lo: “‘...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'”

gt: Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to take off The One Ring or to cancel a skirmish involving the Ring-bearer and a Nazgul.
lo: “With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.”

gt: Maneuver: Spot Sting or Glamdring and exert its bearer X times to wound X Orcs or X Uruk-hai.
lo: “Glamdring shone with a pale light, and Sting glinted at the edges.”

gt: Fellowship: Play Gandalf or Aragorn; his twilight cost is -2.
lo: “Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quite forgetful of their danger.”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.
lo: “Thank you, I shall certainly come.”

gt: Plays to your support area. While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.
lo: “‘But I'm glad Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a tale, you may spot Bilbo to draw a card.
lo: “‘Don't adventures ever have an end? I suppose not. Someone else always has to carry on the story.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert Sam twice to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘First he was a conspirator, now he's a jester. He'll end up by becoming a wizard – or a warrior!'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Bilbo from your draw deck.
Forest. Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play your site 2 (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
Fellowship: Play a [SHIRE] ally to draw a card.
Underground. The twilight cost of the first [MORIA] archer played each Shadow phase is -2.
Plains. Uruk-hai are not roaming.
River. Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to Valley of the Silverlode, each Hobbit companion may heal.
Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -2.
lo: “‘In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, you may draw a card.
lo: “‘When evening in the Shire was grey / his footsteps on the Hill were heard; / before the dawn he went away / on journey long without a word.'”

gt: Tale. Bearer must be a Dwarf. At the start of each fellowship phase when the fellowship is at site 4 or higher, you may draw a card for each Dwarf companion.
lo: “‘It seems to be a record of the fortunes of Balin's folk....'”

gt: Bearer must be Gimli. Fellowship: Exert Gimli to add 1 to the number of pipes you can spot.
lo: “‘And certainly it was from Bree that the art of smoking the genuine weed spread in the recent centuries among Dwarves and such other folk....'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [DWARVEN] tale, you may heal a Dwarf companion.
lo: “‘Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Dwarf ally to heal a Dwarf companion.
lo: “‘There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'”

gt: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each [MORIA] weapon is +2. Fellowship: Discard this condition to discard up to 2 [MORIA] conditions.
lo: “No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....”

gt: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Shuffle up to X [DWARVEN] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lo: “‘I will be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'”

gt: Ranger. Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'”

gt: While you can spot 3 [ELVEN] allies whose home is site 3, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lo: “Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an [ELVEN] ally to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If that card is an [ELVEN] card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.
lo: “‘Tinúviel! Tinúviel! / He called her by her elvish name; / And there she halted listening.'”

gt: Archer. Regroup: Exert Calaglin to wound a minion.
lo: “‘We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north toward Moria....'”

gt: Maneuver: Spot an Elf to make each opponent discard a card from his or her hand. Draw a card for each card discarded in this way.
lo: “‘It should have been cast then into Orodruin's fire nigh at hand where it was made.'”

gt: Archer. Regroup: Exert Dinendal to remove (2).
lo: “He was almost certain that he could hear stealthy movements.... Not Elves; for the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements.”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 to heal that ally twice. Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
lo: “Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [SAURON] minion or [SAURON] event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 [ELVEN] allies to wound a minion.
lo: “‘Alas for Lothlórien that I love! It would be a poor life in a land where no mallorn grew.'”

gt: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X [ELVEN] allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lo: “‘You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lo: “‘There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner's hand.
lo: “‘My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'”

gt: To play, spot Arwen. Bearer must be Aragorn. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.
lo: “‘It is mine to give to whom I will... like my heart.'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.
lo: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.

gt: Bearer must be Legolas. Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
lo: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

gt: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Elrond (or 2 [ELVEN] allies) to heal a companion or ally.
lo: “‘Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'”

gt: Bearer must be Galadriel. At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
lo: “‘Verily it is in the land of Lórien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.'”

gt: To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Bearer's resistance is +2.
lo: “‘May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make an Uruk-hai strength -1.
lo: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.

gt: Fellowship or Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard an [ISENGARD] possession or [ISENGARD] artifact.
lo: “‘We have hunted and slain many Orcs in the woods....'”

gt: Bearer must be Elrond. Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice and spot a Shadow condition to return that condition to its owner's hand.
lo: “Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.”

gt: Tale. Skirmish: Exert an Elf at a river or forest to cancel a skirmish involving that Elf.
lo: “‘Beside the falls of Nimrodel, / By water clear and cool, / Her voice as falling silver fell / Into the shining pool.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1). Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
lo: “‘There is only one Lord of the Ring.'”

gt: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard all Shadow conditions.
lo: “He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....”

gt: Stealth. Maneuver: At sites 1 to 5, spot Gandalf to prevent Hobbits from being assigned to skirmishes until the regroup phase. At any other site, spot Gandalf to make a Hobbit strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Be careful, both of you.'”

gt: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 [GANDALF] or up to 2 [SHIRE] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: “‘The finest rockets ever seen: / they burst in stars of blue and green....'”

gt: Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. You may add (X) to discard that card, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lo: “...a false turn now might be disastrous.”

gt: Bearer must be Gandalf. At the start of each of your turns, you may add (3) to remove a burden.
lo: “‘For this is the Ring of Fire, and with it you may rekindle hearts in a world that grows chill.'”

t: Trust Me as You Once Did
gt: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make a companion strength +1 for each companion with the Gandalf signet you can spot (limit +3).
lo: “‘Do not take me for some conjurer of cheap tricks! I am not trying to rob you. I am trying to help you.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot 4 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to prevent that wound.
lo: “Suddenly he stopped as if listening. Frodo became aware that all was very quiet, inside and outside.”

gt: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a [GONDOR] tale from hand to make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2.
lo: “Drawing his bright sword and crying Elendil! Elendil! he crashed through the trees.”

gt: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (2).
lo: “‘...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'”

gt: Tale. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] companion to make that companion strength +3 and defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. You may heal a [GONDOR] companion at the end of each turn during which no companion or ally lost a skirmish.
lo: “‘One day our paths will lead us there, and the Tower guards shall take up the call – The Lords of Gondor have returned.'”

gt: Tale. Plays to your support area. Archery: Exert a [GONDOR] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lo: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

gt: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lo: “On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....”

gt: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [GONDOR] companion to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X companions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lo: “‘But the lords of Minas Tirith still fight on....'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a [GONDOR] card from hand here. Fellowship: Add (1) to take a card stacked here into hand.
lo: “‘...Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it had not yet been forged again.'”

gt: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [GONDOR] companion to make the twilight cost of each maneuver event +2.
lo: “‘In the south the realm of Gondor long endured; and for a while its splendour grew....'”

gt: Skirmish: Spot The Shards of Narsil to make a [GONDOR] companion strength +3 and damage +1.
lo: “‘The shards of Narsil... the blade that cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make each companion with the Aragorn signet damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: “As he ran the cries came louder, but fainter now and desperately the horn was blowing.”

gt: Response: If the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, exert a [GONDOR] companion twice to make each minion's twilight cost +1 until the next regroup phase.
lo: “‘This is the lawn of Parth Galen: a fair place in the summer days of old. Let us hope that no evil has yet come here.'”

gt: Shadow: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
lo: “‘And why not, Gandalf?... Why not? The Ruling Ring? If we could command that, then the power would pass to us.'”

t: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
gt: Maneuver: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion to exhaust Aragorn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.
Regroup: Reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Heal X [ISENGARD] minions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lo: “‘This evil cannot be concealed by the power of the Elves....'”

t: A Fell Voice on the Air
gt: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [ISENGARD] weather condition from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lo: “‘He's trying to bring down the mountain!'”

gt: Shadow: Spot an Uruk-hai and a [MORIA] minion to draw 3 cards.
lo: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

gt: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard this condition to add (3).
lo: “‘Rip them all down!'”

gt: Bearer must be an [ISENGARD] Orc. When you play this weapon, add (1).
lo: Axes eat into the forests of Isengard as well as the victims of Saruman's Orcs.

gt: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lo: “‘I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'”

gt: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lo: “‘...the Eagles of the mountain went far and wide, and they saw many things: the gathering of wolves and the mustering of Orcs....'”

gt: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lo: The servants of Isengard worked tirelessly to spread the influence of their master.

gt: Response: If an [ISENGARD] Orc is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.'”

gt: Regroup: Exert this minion to discard a weapon (or all Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 5 companions).
lo: “‘No other folk make such a trampling....'”

gt: While you can spot another [ISENGARD] Orc, no player may use archery special abilities. Regroup: Exert this minion and spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer to exert every companion.
lo: “‘There is evil afoot in Isengard, and the West is no longer safe.'”

gt: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lo: “‘They were Elves once. Taken by the dark powers – tortured and mutilated....'”

t: One of You Must Do This

gt: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow this companion to skirmish.

gt: Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil. Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.
lo: “‘Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'”

gt: To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: Spot 2 [SHIRE] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [SHIRE] companion.
lo: “‘Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'”

gt: If an opponent plays a minion, exert a Dwarf who is damage +X to exert that minion X times.
lo: “‘“Oft hope is born, when all is forlorn.”'”

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [DWARVEN] condition from hand or from your discard pile.
lo: “‘Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'”

gt: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.
lo: “‘...whatever is still to do, I hope to have a part in it, for the honour of the folk of the Lonely Mountain.'”

gt: Skirmish: Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound [ELVEN] companion strength -1 for each archer you spot.
lo: Affectionately referred to as ‘Figwit' by his contemporaries in Rivendell.

gt: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an [ELVEN] card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lo: “‘...mine is the choice of Lúthien, and as she so have I chosen, both the sweet and the bitter.'”

gt: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2 for each wounded minion you can spot.
lo: “‘“Often is it seen,” said Aragorn, “that in dangerous days men hide their chief treasure.”'”

gt: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
lo: “...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.”

gt: To play, spot 2 Elves. Skirmish: Exert Cirdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [ELVEN] event in your discard pile.
lo: “...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, you may heal another Elf.
lo: “‘To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting – but to you hope of joy for a while.'”

gt: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.
lo: Not all Elven weapons are carried in sheath or quiver.

gt: When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3. Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [ELVEN] event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.
lo: “‘I pass the test,' she said. ‘I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'”

gt: To play, spot 2 Elves. Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength -4 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) from a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifact.
lo: “...the hand that held it sparkled with white fire.”

gt: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.
lo: “...the wanderers were lifted up and borne far away out of the darkness and the fire.”

gt: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a [GANDALF] companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.
lo: “‘...tomorrow will be certain to bring worse than today, for many days to come.'”

gt: Exert your Wizard and choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lo: “...the rush of their wide wings as they passed over was like a gale.”

gt: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.
lo: “...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....”

gt: To play, spot 3 [GANDALF] companions. Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a [GANDALF] condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
lo: “‘Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.'”

gt: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost -2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.
lo: “Something struck Sam violently in the back....”

gt: Any site 9 is a Mountain. Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile. Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.
lo: “The fires below awoke in anger....”

gt: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.
lo: “...swiftly but warily, creeping on behind, a slinking shadow among the stones.”

gt: Assignment: Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum. Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.
lo: “...white fangs gleamed, and then snapped as they bit.”

gt: Enduring. Fierce. When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.
lo: “...she served none but herself, drinking the blood of Elves and Men....”

gt: While you have initiative, each [GOLLUM] minion is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [GOLLUM] minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.
lo: “...she lusted for sweeter meat. And Gollum had brought it to her.”

gt: When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
lo: “‘Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'”

gt: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another [GONDOR] Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: “...a black dread fell on them....”

gt: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play this companion, exert him twice.
lo: “...the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them....”

gt: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [GONDOR] card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
lo: “There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....”

gt: For each [GONDOR] companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.
lo: “‘We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'”

gt: Make an exhausted [GONDOR] companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her damage +1.
lo: “...he drew Andúril and held it up glittering in the sun. ‘You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought,' he said.”

gt: Spot a [GONDOR] Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a fortification.
lo: “And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour....”

gt: Fortification. Bearer is strength -1 for each Fortification you can spot. Maneuver: Exert 2 [GONDOR] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.
lo: “A strong citadel it was indeed....”

gt: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.
lo: “All before the walls on either side of the Gate the ground was choked with wreck and with bodies of the slain....”

gt: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
lo: “‘We must push Sauron... We must march out to meet him at once.'”

gt: Each site on the adventure path is a battleground. While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.
lo: “‘For we are already at war, as you may have seen....'”

gt: Regroup: Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove (3) to wound an unbound companion.
lo: “‘With horns in my mouth / I walk in the South....'”

gt: Corsair. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Shadow: Exert this minion to play a [RAIDER] support area possession from your draw deck.
lo: Promise of plunder and of the whip keep in line a lustful Corsair crew.

gt: Corsair. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a [RAIDER] token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.
lo: “...the region of South Gondor became a debatable land between the Corsairs and the Kings.”

gt: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may spot another corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lo: An incarnation of savagery was Ghynóh the Cruel.

gt: Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling. While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2. Skirmish: Wound 2 other [RAIDER] Men to heal this minion.
lo: “...from nearby there marched up an army of Easterlings that had waited for the signal....”

gt: Easterling. Fierce. When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion you spot over 5.
lo: “...for the sack of the City and the rape of Gondor....”

gt: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another [RAIDER] Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.
lo: “...men like half-trolls, with white eyes and red tongues.”

gt: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that character is strength -1. Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.
Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.
lo: Southrons rain arrows down upon their enemies from their defended perch atop their great beasts of war.

gt: Southron. When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lo: The commander of a mûmak never imagines he is in complete control of the beast.

gt: Exert a [RAIDER] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a [ROHAN] Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.
lo: Against the great mounts of the Southron army, Rohirrim steeds could not easily prevail.

gt: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards. Shadow: Remove (1) and play a Southron to add a threat.
lo: “Horns were blown and trumpets were braying....”

gt: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is enduring. Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a [RAIDER] condition from your discard pile.
lo: Only by many conquests and hardships does one rise to prominence in the army of the Haradrim.

gt: Southron. Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.
lo: Stirred by the Dark Lord, the fullness of Southron cruelty was leveled at the people of Gondor.

gt: Southron. While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lo: The merciless deserts of Haradwaith breed equally merciless fighters.

gt: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a [RAIDER] card to discard that possession. If that possession was a [GONDOR] or [ROHAN] possession, wound an unbound Man.
lo: “...the Mûmak of Harad was indeed a beast of vast bulk, and the like of him does not walk now in Middle-earth....”

gt: Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [RAIDER] Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [RAIDER] Man strength +2.
lo: “‘I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'”

gt: Shadow: Exert a Nazgul and play a [WRAITH] minion to add (1) (or (2) if you have initiative).
lo: “...at their head was one greater than all the rest: a Rider, all black....”

gt: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.
lo: “A noise of tramping feet and harsh shouts: Orcs were coming up to the Cleft from the far side....”

gt: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “...not even the black shadows, lying deep where the red glow could not reach, would shield him long from the night-eyed orcs.”

gt: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “...deafening, roaring in his ears, the crash of the feet and the rending clamour of the Orcs before him.”

gt: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.
lo: “Sam looked up towards the orc-tower, and suddenly from its narrow windows lights stared out like small red eyes.”

gt: Heal an enduring [WRAITH] minion to add a burden or 2 threats.
lo: “‘...how can he win to the Gate, if these foul hell-hawks have other weapons than fear?'”

gt: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each [WRAITH] Orc is strength +1.
lo: “‘I tell you, it's no game serving down in the city.'”

gt: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] Orc. When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead. If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.
lo: “‘You touch it and I'll stick this blade in your gut.'”

gt: Make a [WRAITH] minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).
lo: “‘...thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.'”

gt: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an archer.
lo: “So great an army had never issued from that vale since the days of Isildur's might....”

gt: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.
lo: “‘...soon the host of Morgul will enter in at many points.'”

gt: While you have initiative, each of your [WRAITH] minions is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [WRAITH] minion strength +2.
lo: “And with a piercing cry out of the dim sky fell the winged shadows....”

gt: Maneuver: Spot a [WRAITH] Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.
lo: “‘...in secret they have long been building floats and barges in great number in East Osgiliath.'”

gt: Make a [WRAITH] Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lo: “The passage of Anduin was won by the Enemy.”

gt: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Cantea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Cantea to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lo: “...the shadows of death fell dark upon the earth.”

gt: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Enquea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: If Ulaire Enquea is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.
lo: “Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.”

gt: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Lemenya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Lemenya to wound up to 3 other [WRAITH] minions.
lo: “It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor's greatest foe.”

gt: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Nelya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Nelya to add (1) for each burden.
lo: “Perching now on the wall beside the ruined gate the Nazgûl sent out its deadly cries. All the cliffs echoed.”

gt: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Toldea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Toldea to make him damage +1.
lo: “...like shadows of untimely night, he saw in the middle airs below him five birdlike forms...”

gt: Skirmish: Exert Eowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Eowyn.
lo: “‘Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'”

gt: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.
lo: “...he seized a great horn from Guthláf his banner-bearer, and he blew such a blast upon it that it burst asunder.”

gt: If your [ROHAN] Man wins a skirmish, discard a [ROHAN] possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.
lo: “...they gathered and rallied and fought until the day wore away.”

gt: Each roaming [SAURON] minion is damage +1.
lo: The foe who gave him his scar soon after gave him the adornment for his helm.

gt: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a roaming [SAURON] minion strength +3.
lo: “The sun gleamed red....”

gt: Each roaming [SAURON] minion is fierce.
lo: “In vain men shook their fists at the pitiless foes that swarmed before the Gate.”

gt: Shadow: Exert or discard this minion to make each [SAURON] minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.
lo: “The lines of fire became flowing torrents, file upon file of Orcs bearing flames....”

gt: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion. Shadow: Discard this condition to play a [SAURON] minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lo: “There the last living things gave up their struggle....”

gt: Make a [SAURON] minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “The Rammas was broken, and all the Pelennor abandoned to the Enemy.”

gt: Damage +1.
lo: “...this stronghold had been built not to keep enemies out of Mordor, but to keep them in.”

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is fierce.
lo: “‘A message came: “Nazgûl uneasy. Spies feared on stairs. Double vigiliance. Patrol to head of Stairs.'””

gt: Damage +1. If you can spot another [SAURON] Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost -1 for each possession you can spot.
lo: “‘Any trespasser found by the guard is to be held at the tower.'”

gt: Damage +1.
lo: “...treachery had yielded up the Tower to the Lord of the Ringwraiths, and now for long years it had been held by evil things.”

gt: While you have initiative, each of your [SAURON] minions is strength +2. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [SAURON] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).
lo: “Soon there was great peril of fire behind the wall....”

gt: Besieger. While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is -2. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.
lo: “...new foes came swirling behind....”

gt: Besieger. When you play this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another besieger to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.
lo: “File after file passed....”

gt: Besieger. When you play Gothmog, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion for each site you control. While you control a site, Gothmog is fierce.
lo: “‘Move into the City. Kill all in your path.'”

gt: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. For each site you control, bearer is strength +1 (or +2 if bearer is Gothmog).
lo: “‘Form ranks, you maggots! Form ranks!'”

gt: Each [SAURON] Orc bearing a possession cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lo: “There came a long rolling of great drums like thunder in the mountains....”

gt: Shadow: If you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).
lo: “The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....”

gt: Besieger. Fierce. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [SAURON] minion to control a site. If you cannot spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.
Shadow: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and exert another [SAURON] minion twice to add (3) and draw a card.
lo: “...a braying of horns... shook the very stones and stunned men's ears.”

gt: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Shadow: Remove 2 threats to discard a condition.
lo: “The Captains of the West were foundering in a gathering sea.”

gt: Enduring. For each wound on this minion, it is strength +2.
lo: “All about the hills the hosts of Mordor raged.”

gt: Each time a roaming [SAURON] minion takes a wound, you may add a [SAURON] token here. Regroup: Exert an Uruk-hai or discard a [SAURON] minion to add a [SAURON] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [SAURON] tokens from here to make a [SAURON] minion strength +2.
lo: “...even fear by night had scarcely over-counted them.”

gt: If a burden is added, spot a [SAURON] minion to add an additional burden.
lo: “‘...I do not choose now to do what I came to do. I will not do this deed.'”

gt: If the Free Peoples player plays a possession, discard a [SAURON] minion from hand to prevent him or her from playing any more cards until the end of this phase.
lo: “...they began to throw missiles marvelously high, so that they passed right above the battlement and fell thudding within the first circle of the City....”

gt: Damage +1. Each time Shagrat loses a skirmish, you may exert a character.
lo: “‘If you think I'm so damaged that it's safe to flout me, you're mistaken.'”

gt: Exert a [SAURON] minion to return a Free Peoples condition to its owner's hand (or 2 if both are [SHIRE] conditions).
lo: “‘Go slow! Bring no fire to this place while Faramir lives! Do nothing until Gandalf comes!'”

gt: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you can spot.
lo: “...these fell creatures would bite the throats of those that they threw down.”

gt: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Minion. If bearer is an Uruk-hai, it is strength +2.
lo: A sharp edge for the sharp-natured.

gt: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may remove a threat to wound an unbound companion.
lo: “...as from some great window immeasurably high there stabbed northward a flame of red, the flicker of a piercing Eye....”

gt: Fellowship: Add a burden to choose 2 [SHIRE] events with different card titles from your discard pile. Choose an opponent and make him or her choose 1 of those cards for you to take into hand.
lo: “‘...he caught Déagol by the throat and strangled him, because the gold looked so bright and beautiful.'”

gt: If a Hobbit companion is not assigned to a skirmish, exert that Hobbit to have him or her replace a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in a skirmish.
lo: “‘Now come, you filth!' he cried. ‘You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it.'”

gt: If there are 4 or more [SHIRE] cards in your discard pile, make a Hobbit strength +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.
lo: “‘...he thought he saw something shining in the river-bed; and holding his breath he grabbed at it.'”

gt: Play this condition only during a skirmish. Bearer must be a Hobbit. When this condition is played, wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
lo: “And there stood Meriadoc the hobbit in the midst of the slain, blinking like an owl in the daylight, for tears blinded him....”

gt: Each time you lose initiative, you may spot 2 [SHIRE] companions to remove a burden.
lo: “Far off, as in a little picture drawn by elven-fingers, he saw the Lady Galadriel standing on the grass in Lórien, and gifts were in her hands.”

gt: Stealth. Spot a [SHIRE] companion and return him or her to your hand to make a Shadow player choose to remove (2) or discard a minion.
lo: “‘There's something still alive in that place, something with eyes, or a seeing mind, if you take me; and the longer we stay in one spot, the sooner it will get on to us.'”

gt: Exert a Hobbit to make another Hobbit strength +3.
lo: “Howling with pain and fear but desperate the orc charged head-down at him.”

gt: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make a Shadow player discard a minion (or spot 4 Hobbit companions to make that player discard 2 minions).
lo: “‘If those two had seen us, they would have dropped all their quarrel until we were dead.'”

t: Nine-fingered Frodo and the Ring of Doom
gt: Tale. Exert a [SHIRE] character to remove a burden or 2 threats.
lo: “‘What a tale we have been in, Mr. Frodo, haven't we?'”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Each Orc and each Uruk-hai skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
lo: “‘Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc, if I may make so bold....'”

gt: To play, spot 2 [SHIRE] companions. Each time a minion is played, you may exert a Hobbit companion to exert that minion (limit once per turn).
lo: “...it saw a great silent shape, cloaked in a grey shadow, looming against the wavering light behind....”

gt: Stealth. If there are 6 or more [SHIRE] cards in your discard pile, cancel a skirmish involving your Hobbit and a minion who is not fierce. Each minion in that skirmish is fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “...harsh and loud they heard orc-voices.”

t: The Tale of the Great Ring
gt: Tale. Skirmish: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless a Shadow event is (or was) played during this skirmish. Discard this condition.
lo: “‘I have quite finished, Sam,' said Frodo. ‘The last pages are for you.'”

gt: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to play a fortification from your draw deck.
Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.
Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.
Skirmish: Spot your [WRAITH] Orc and remove 2 threats to make that [WRAITH] Orc strength +3.
Ring-bearer (resistance 12).
lo: “‘...if it's the only way, we must take it.'”

gt: Ring-bound. Sam is strength +1 for each [SHIRE] companion you can spot. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘...I'd say there's a large warrior on the loose, Elf most likely, with an elf-sword anyway....'”

gt: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
lo: “‘...ash nazg thrakatulûk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. While bearer is at a mountain site, he is damage +1.
lo: The Dwarves led by Balin to the great Dwarf-hall of old, though ill-prepared, were well-armed.

gt: Spot a Dwarf. For each wound on that Dwarf, make him strength +2 and damage +1.
lo: As had the children of Durin and the followers of Balin before him, Gimli would fight the interlopers in Khazad-dûm with all his strength.

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each companion is damage +1. Discard this condition at the end of your turn.
lo: Glóin and his countrymen stood as reassurance that the Dwarves would also stand against the will of the Dark Lord.

gt: Exert the Ring-bearer and a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +X, where X equals that Dwarf's resistance.
