gt: Toil 3. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.) Assign an [ORC] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lo: Easily caught by the heat of battle, Orc soldiers often break formation and attack where their bloodlust takes them.

gt: Skirmish: If this minion is at an underground site, exert it to exert a companion it is skirmishing.
lo: In the rush of battle, some Orcs can carry on heedless of their own wounds until their enemy is vanquished.

gt: When you play this minion, you may spot another [ORC] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.
lo: Some Orcs have learned basic tracking skills.

gt: When you play this condition, spot a mounted [ROHAN] Man to add 3 [ROHAN] tokens here. Response: If a minion is played at a plains site, discard this condition or remove a [ROHAN] token from here to exert that minion.
lo: “‘Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?'”

gt: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert Eomer to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lo: “‘...wanderers in the Riddermark would be wise to be less haughty in these days of doubt.'”

gt: Each time Eowyn wins a skirmish, each other [ROHAN] Man is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘The women of this country learned long ago: those without swords can still die upon them.'”

gt: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add (1) to play a possession on Gamling from your draw deck.
lo: “‘If they come to bargain for our goods at Helm's Gate, they will pay a high price....'”

gt: Response: If a [ROHAN] companion who has resistance 4 or more is about to take a wound, exert Hrothlac to prevent that.
lo: “‘...we desire only to be free, and to live as we have lived, keeping our own, and serving no foreign lord, good or evil.'”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [ROHAN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Assignment: Discard this condition from play to make bearer defender +1.
lo: “‘ are welcome here in days of war but our own folk....'”

gt: Make a [ROHAN] Man who has resistance 4 or more strength +2 for each wound on each minion he or she is skirmishing.
lo: “‘...a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!”

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if the fellowship is at a plains site).
lo: Short-hafted throwing spears are wielded by the Riders of Rohan in addition to their long lances.

gt: When you play this companion, each [ROHAN] companion is strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lo: “...their faces were stern and keen.”

gt: To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] companions. You may play Riders of the Mark any time you could play a skirmish event. When you play Riders of the Mark, you may exhaust a minion.
lo: “With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round.”

gt: To play, exert a [ROHAN] Man. While you can spot 2 [ROHAN] mounts, the move limit is +1. Each of your companions that is not mounted is strength -1.
lo: “The horsemen, following the trail, had turned from the river and were drawing near the downs.”

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. While bearer is at a plains site, he or she is defender +1.
lo: The Eorlingas raise horses both peerless and cherished.

gt: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Each time a Shadow condition is played, you may exert a minion. Response: If a minion exerts as a cost of its special ability, discard this condition to prevent that and return that minion to its owner's hand.
lo: “‘Ride now, ride now! Ride to Gondor!'”

gt: Response: If a [ROHAN] possession is discarded from play and no more than one possession is stacked here, stack it here. Fellowship: Add (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lo: In Rohan, equal craft is brought to the exhibition of a blade as to the forging.

gt: While you can spot a [GANDALF] companion, Theoden gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While Theoden is at a battleground or plains site each [ROHAN] Man is strength +1.
lo: “‘Let all my folk get ready!'”

gt: Exert a [ROHAN] companion to make him or her strength +3 (and damage +1 if he or she has resistance 5 or more).
lo: “‘Mourn not overmuch! Mighty was the fallen, / meet was his ending. When his mound is raised, / women then shall weep.'”

gt: For each dwelling and forest site on the adventure path, make a Hobbit strength +1.
lo: “...they love peace and quiet and good tilled earth; a well-ordered and well-farmed countryside was their favorite haunt.”

gt: Stealth. Cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit and a minion whose strength is lower than that Hobbit's resistance.
lo: “Frodo felt a sudden chill running through him and clutching at his heart....”

gt: While Farmer Maggot is at a dwelling or forest site, he is strength +4.
lo: “‘I didn't like the looks of him; and when Grip came out, he took one sniff and let out a yelp as if he had been stung....'”

gt: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. At the start of the regroup phase, you may exert Frodo to make him gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lo: “‘I will take the Ring... though I do not know the way.'”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [SHIRE] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a Hobbit. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time the fellowship moves from a dwelling or forest site, remove (1).
lo: “‘What about second breakfast?'”

gt: Stealth. If the fellowship is at a dwelling site, exert 2 Hobbits to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, exert 2 Hobbits to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lo: “‘I am Mr. Underhill, if any name must be given.'”

gt: For each other unbound companion assigned to a skirmish, Merry is strength +2.
lo: “‘We can't leave Frodo! Pippin and I always intended to go wherever he went, and we still do.'”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [SHIRE] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot 2 [SHIRE] companions to remove 2 burdens.
lo: “‘This, my friend, is a pint!'”

gt: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, spot an unbound companion who has less resistance than Pippin to have Pippin replace him or her in a skirmish.
lo: “Merry and he had drawn their swords, but the Orcs did not wish to fight....”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is an unbound Hobbit, discard this possession to prevent him or her from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
Ring-bound. Each other companion is resistance +1.
lo: “‘I'm coming too, or neither of us is going. I'll knock holes in all the boats first.'”

gt: Bearer must be Bilbo, Frodo, or Sam. Maneuver: If bearer is Bilbo or Frodo, exert him to make another companion resistance +2 until the regroup phase. If bearer is Sam, each time he wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lo: This blade has dealt many wounds, by many hands.

gt: Make a Hobbit strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 7 or more.
lo: “‘It's just something Gandalf said. ... “Don't you lose him, Samwise Gamgee.” And I don't mean to.'”

t: A Task Now to Be Done
gt: Spot X Hobbits to make an unbound Hobbit resistance +X.
lo: “Another opportunity for one of the shire-folk to prove their great worth. You must not fail me.”

gt: Heal a Hobbit for each minion you spot.
lo: “‘So far so good; but how are we to avoid being spitted?'”

gt: Damage +1. Each Free Peoples archer who has resistance 5 or less does not add to the Free Peoples archery total.
lo: Volleys of arrows are no defense against the onslaught of Saruman's servants.

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lo: Bred for endurance, the Uruk-hai pursue their foes tirelessly.

gt: Damage +1. Response: If a special ability of a companion who has resistance 5 or less is used, exert this minion to cancel its effect.
lo: They are trained to parry the swords of their enemies.

gt: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +1 for each battleground site you can spot.
lo: Uruks are drawn to the sounds of battle.

gt: To play, spot a [URUK-HAI] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may draw a card.
lo: As their prey grows tired, the Uruks gain the advantage.

gt: If your [URUK-HAI] minion wins a skirmish, discard a condition from play.
lo: The villages hold nothing of value to the Uruk-hai; they are simply things to be destroyed.

gt: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +1 and damage +1.
lo: Only in combat is an Uruk-hai truly fulfilling its purpose.

gt: Damage +1. Each time this minion is about to take a wound at a battleground site, you may spot another [URUK-HAI] card to make the Free Peoples player draw a card instead.
lo: Despite their bloodthirsty nature, Saruman's creations form armies and fight united for him.

gt: When you play this condition, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to add 3 [URUK-HAI] tokens here. Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove an [URUK-HAI] token from here to prevent that.
lo: Resiliency is bred into the fighting Uruk-hai.

gt: Damage +1. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each companion and Free Peoples possession loses its special abilities.
lo: The Uruk-hai attack with such ferocity that their victims find no way to strike back.

gt: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2 (or +3 if you can spot an exhausted companion).
lo: Uruk soldiers have learned to save their rage for the field of battle.

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lo: An enemy on the move is an enemy unprepared.

gt: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -2 until the end of the turn.
lo: In battle, the Uruk-hai inspire terror in even the bravest of their enemies.

gt: Damage +1. While this minion is at a battleground site, it cannot take wounds. While you can spot 6 companions, each [URUK-HAI] minion cannot take wounds.
lo: Like a force of nature, the Uruks are unstoppable.

gt: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. While bearer is at a battleground site, it is an archer.
lo: Saruman's machine works also makes formidable heavy bows for the Uruk-hai.

gt: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each character skirmishing bearer is strength -2.
lo: The heavy-backed Uruk blades hack through armor and flesh alike.

gt: Damage +1. The fellowship's current site gains battleground.
lo: Choice of terrain is important when engaging the enemy.

gt: Archer. Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Lurtz is strength +3 for each exhausted companion you can spot.
lo: Saruman bred this ruthless commander, whose brutality matched his own ambition, to track the Nine Walkers.

gt: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lo: Like a machine of Saruman, his minions are created for one purpose – killing.

gt: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
lo: Saruman's Uruk-hai are instilled with his ideas of destiny and supremacy.

gt: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is strength +3.
lo: They make short work of the weak.

gt: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less, this minion cannot take wounds.
lo: Their toughness comes from both armor and hide.

gt: Damage +1. Each time a Free Peoples event is played during a skirmish involving this minion, this minion is strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lo: Single-minded in purpose, the Uruk-hai are not easily swayed from their intended path.

gt: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 3 or less, you may exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that character.
lo: Weapons mean little against the strength of Uruks.

gt: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert or discard this minion to prevent that.
lo: Uruks are trained to safeguard their commanders.

gt: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 4 or less, this minion is damage +1.
lo: Fighting in packs, the Uruk-hai feast on the weak.

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot another [URUK-HAI] minion assigned to a skirmish, this minion cannot take wounds.
lo: Like pack animals, the Uruk-hai find strength in numbers.

gt: Damage +1. Toil 1. (For each [URUK-HAI] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
lo: Huge, terrifying Uruks become tribal leaders.

gt: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) This minion is strength +2 for each [URUK-HAI] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lo: Some of the Uruks watch for stragglers and make certain they don't escape alive.

gt: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, you may draw a card.
lo: Advanced Uruk scouts search for enemy weaknesses.

gt: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgul to draw 3 cards.
lo: The Witch-king nearly seized the Ring in Frodo's moment of weakness.

gt: Each time your [WRAITH] minion wins a skirmish, you may discard this condition to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lo: The wicked, flying beasts of the Ringwraiths snatched warriors from the battlefield and flung them like leaves in the wind.

gt: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish involving a [WRAITH] minion, you may shuffle a [WRAITH] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: “Suddenly the foremost Rider spurred his horse forward.”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgul to add a burden.
lo: The piercing cries of the Nazgûl paralyze their enemies with fear.

gt: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a companion your Nazgul is skirmishing. Limit 1 per companion. Each [WRAITH] minion skirmishing bearer is strength +1 for each forest site you can spot.
Shadow: Spot a Nazgul and reveal a Nazgul from hand to place the revealed card beneath your draw deck and draw a card.
lo: “‘I thought there were two or three black shapes.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Nazgul. If bearer is The Witch-king, each time he wins a skirmish, you may exert him to add a burden.
lo: “‘Die now and curse in vain!' And with that he lifted high his sword and flames ran down the blade.”

gt: Reveal your hand to make a [WRAITH] minion strength +1 for each [WRAITH] minion in your hand.
lo: “‘The Nine are abroad again.'”

gt: Maneuver: Remove (5) to make this condition a fierce [WRAITH] minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 3 vitality, and cannot bear other cards. This card is still a condition. At the start of the regroup phase, remove all tokens from here.

Regroup: Discard your Nazgul from play to add a [WRAITH] token here. The Free Peoples player may return a companion to hand to prevent the placement of that token. When you can spot 4 [WRAITH] tokens on this condition, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
To play, spot a Nazgul. Each time the Free Peoples player plays a companion, that companion is exhausted unless the Free Peoples player pays its twilight cost again.
lo: Encircled, with nowhere to retreat, Aragorn could only hope to drive back the Nazgûl.

gt: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Attea is assigned to a fierce skirmish involving a character who has resistance 4 or less, you may exert Ulaire Attea to add a burden.
lo: “‘Hissed at me, he did. It gave me quite a shudder.'”

gt: While Ulaire Cantea is at a forest or dwelling site, he is strength +2 and fierce.
lo: “‘It's from Hobbiton that this here black rider comes, unless there's more than one.'”

gt: Each character skirmishing Ulaire Lemenya who has resistance 5 or less is strength -3.
lo: “Terror overcame Pippin and Merry, and they threw themselves flat on the ground.”

gt: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.
lo: “‘There's been a strange customer asking for Mr. Baggins of Bag End, and he's only just gone.'”

gt: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) While Ulaire Nertea is at a forest site, he is strength +2. While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgul is strength +2.
lo: Sauron's servants interrogate with terror and torture.

gt: When you play Ulaire Otsea, you may spot a companion who has X wounds to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take each [WRAITH] card revealed this way into hand.
lo: “The riding figure sat quite still with its head bowed, as if listening.”

gt: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Toldea wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lo: The terrifying pursuit of the Nazgûl on their Black Steeds drives their victims headlong into the wild.

gt: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lo: “...a shape, black-mantled, huge and threatening.”

gt: River. The minion archery total is +2 for each companion in the fellowship over 4.
River. When the fellowship moves to this site, discard each ally from play.
Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a Dwarf to play a [DWARF] possession from your draw deck.
Dwelling. Shadow: Play a Nazgul to discard a condition from play.
Forest. No more than 1 minion can be assigned to each skirmish.
Underground. Skirmish special abilities cannot be used.
Underground. The Free Peoples player may transfer Free Peoples artifacts and possessions at no twilight cost.
Mountain. If this site is in region 2 when the fellowship moves from it during the regroup phase, wound each companion.
Marsh. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may play a [GOLLUM] Free Peoples card from your draw deck.
Forest. Each companion is twilight cost +2.
Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character, (except an enduring character) to make it strength +2.
Marsh. Shadow: If the total number of minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, play a minion at twilight cost -3.
Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each Free Peoples weapon.
Plains. Each unbound companion skirmishing more than 1 minion is strength +3.
Battleground. When the fellowship moves to the site, add 2 for each companion over 5.
Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 2 Hobbits to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.
Plains. Until the regroup phase, each minion skirmishing a [ROHAN] companion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce.
Battleground. Each time a [GANDALF] companion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player may discard a condition from play.
Battleground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.
Marsh. Regroup: Exert your Gollum or your Smeagol to play the fellowship's next site.
Underground. When your fellowship moves from this site, you may spot a Dwarf to draw 2 cards.
Underground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.
Marsh. When the fellowship moves to here, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert each other character.
River. The minion archery total is -3.
Forest. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may heal 2 Elves.
Battleground. When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 burdens to remove a burden.
Plains. Each [MEN] minion gains ambush (1).
Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must add a burden or discard 3 cards from hand.
Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 3 companions to play a Wizard from your dead pile.
Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may add a burden to play a ranger from your draw deck.
Plains. During the archery phase, [URUK] minions cannot take wounds.
Battleground. Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.
At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a [ROHAN] Man to play a [ROHAN] mount from your draw deck.
Forest. Each time you play an artifact or possession on your companion, you may draw a card.
Dwelling. River. When your fellowship moves to this site, you may heal each Hobbit companion.
Mountain. Maneuver: Exert your [ORC] minion to discard a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand.
Underground. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove (2).
Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the Free Peoples player wounds a companion for each ally.
Underground. Each unwounded [GONDOR] Man is defender +1.
Forest. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a Nazgul from your discard pile.
Spot a Dwarf to choose a Shadow player who must spot a race. Discard from play all minions of all other races.
lo: “‘And you, Master Dwarf, pray take your hand from your axe-haft, till I am up! You will not need such arguments.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonus. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer one of bearer's possessions to another eligible bearer.
lo: “‘We make good armour and keen swords....'”

gt: Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish in which you played a [DWARVEN] event, you may draw a card.
lo: “...crying strange news in the dawn.”

gt: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Then, if that Dwarf is at a battleground or mountain site, draw a card.
lo: Gimli unexpectedly faced another test of Dwarven endurance.

gt: Toil 2. (For each [DWARVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 if he has resistance 4 or more).
lo: Gimli's axe-work on the Amon Hen hewed a mighty path through the Uruk-hai.

gt: When you play this companion during the fellowship phase, choose a Shadow player who must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lo: Though Dáin rules Erebor as King Under the Mountain, many of his kindred continue to dwell in  the Iron Hills.

gt: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Dwarf strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a mountain or underground site; he has resistance 3 or more; he is bearing a possession; he is skirmishing a fierce minion.
lo: A sharpened axe does well to protect Dwarven honor.

gt: Skirmish: Discard a [DWARVEN] card from hand and spot a minion skirmishing a Dwarf to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Alas! My axe is notched: the forty-second had an iron collar on his neck.'”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [DWARVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot 2 Dwarves to draw up to 4 cards.
lo: “And no regurgitation!”

gt: Each Dwarf is damage +1 for each possession he bears. Fellowship: Discard this condition to play a [DWARVEN] possession from your discard pile.
lo: “‘Dwarves' tongues run on when speaking of their handiwork, they say.'”

gt: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +2 for each possession he bears if he has resistance 4 or more).
lo: “Gimli hewed the legs from under another that had sprung up on Balin's Tomb.”

gt: Each Dwarf gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time the fellowship moves from a plains site, discard a card from your hand.
lo: “‘...I am glad to have you standing nigh....'”

gt: For each artifact and possession Thrarin bears, he is damage +1.
lo: Like many other representatives who have come to Rivendell, Thrarin the smith brings troubling news from the East.

gt: Spot an Elf to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal a Shadow card. Make an Elf strength +2 for each card revealed. Place the revealed cards in any order on the bottom of your draw deck.
lo: With deep focus and heightened senses, Elven archers are able to make seemingly impossible shots.

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: If Elrond is skirmishing a minion, exert him to place an [ELVEN] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lo: “‘I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

gt: Bearer must be Arwen or Elrond. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him or her to discard a condition from play.
lo: “This blade is called Hadafang, a noble defense against the enemy throng for a noble lady.”

gt: While Orophin is at a forest site and you can spot another Elf, Orophin is an archer.
lo: “...wolves were howling on the wood's borders: but on the land of Lórien no shadow lay.”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Fellowship: Discard a companion from hand to heal a companion.
lo: “‘Now you shall rest, and we will not speak of your further road for a while.'”

gt: Maneuver: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, Rumil is an archer until the regroup phase.
lo: “...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside....”

gt: Toil 2. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot an Elf companion to discard a condition from play.
lo: “‘We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith. Few indeed are permitted even to set foot there.'”

gt: Toil 1. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Archery: Discard an [ELVEN] character from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1. Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, return your Elf to your hand.

Spell. Toil 3. (For each [GANDALF] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3) Spot a [GANDALF] wizard and X other companions to examine the top X cards of your draw deck. Replace those cards in any order.
lo: “‘I have come back from dark journeys and long search....'”

gt: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.
lo: “‘Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'”

gt: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves from a battleground site, add a burden. Regroup: Add 2 burdens to remove all twilight tokens from the twilight pool.
lo: “He wore a tall pointed blue hat....”

gt: Spell. Choose one: Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions from play; or spot a [GANDALF] Wizard at a battleground site to discard a condition from play.
lo: “‘...I do not know the word – yet. But we shall soon see.'”

gt: At the start of each skirmish involving Jarnsmid, you may remove a burden (or 2 burdens if you can spot another [GANDALF] companion).
lo: Sauron's Easterling allies were another trial for the Bardings, still keenly aware of the great efforts to rebuild Dale.

gt: Spell. To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound that would kill him or her, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lo: “...the whole hall became suddenly dark as night.”

gt: Make a [GANDALF] companion strength +2. Then, if that companion is at a battleground or dwelling site, you may take a [GANDALF] condition from your discard pile into hand.
lo: “The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.”

gt: Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to replace a site in the fellowship's current region with a site from your adventure deck.
lo: “‘...the question is: who will follow me, if I lead you there?'”

gt: To play, spot a [GANDALF] companion. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lo: “‘I could not take it from him without doing greater harm; and I had no right to do so anyway.'”

gt: While Gandalf is at an underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While the fellowship is at a battleground site, each [GANDALF] character gains muster.
lo: “‘We come, we come with roll of drum....'”

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Skirmish: Remove (3) to reinforce a [MEN] token and make bearer fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: Small and light, the boarding axe is ideal for close-quarters fighting aboard ships or in confined spaces.

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is an archer. Each time a companion is killed during the archery phase, you may control a site.
lo: Not nearly as ornate or as accurate as the Gondorian bows, the short-bows of the Corsairs killed just as well.

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. When you play this possession you may reinforce a [MEN] token twice. Each time a companion is killed during a skirmish phase, you may control a site.
lo: A tool equally useful in times of peace and in times of war.

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is damage +1. Shadow: Remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to control a site.
lo: Long handled and heavy, a single powerful swing of this weapon could cleave through even some of the thickest armor.

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is strength +1 for each [MEN] token you can spot (limit +5).
lo: A largely stylistic weapon, scimitars are favored for their light weight yet powerful strikes.

gt: If the Free Peoples player plays a companion, discard a [MEN] card from hand to return that companion to its owner's hand.
lo: During the War of the Ring, the streets of Bree were filled mainly with Southern ruffians and thieves, and Bree-folk were afraid to leave their homes.

gt: When you play this possession, you may add a [MEN] token here. Regroup: Remove 4 [MEN] tokens from here to place a [MEN] card from your discard pile on the top of your draw deck.
lo: "They'll be in the city in two days. You're outnumbered, Aragorn."

gt: Regroup: Exert Grima to add (2). Regroup: Remove a [MEN] token to add (2). Regroup: Remove (4) to exert an unbound companion.
lo: "'You are held wise, my friend Wormtongue, and are doubtless a great support to your master.'"

gt: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lo: "What do you want?"

gt: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lo: Carved from bone or forged from iron, no warrior would enter the fields of battle without a trusty, simple blade.

t: Ill News is an Ill Guest
gt: Exert a [MEN] minion to discard a follower from play (if you can spot Grima, also draw a card).
lo: "Late is the hour in which this conjurer chooses to appear."

gt: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2. Each mounted Man is strength +1. Regroup: Shuffle any number of your [MEN] mounts in play into your draw deck.
lo: With a sound of his horn, a line of Mûmakil appeared and the Pelennor field was filled with chaos.

gt: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lo: "It works for him!"

gt: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lo: Making money and making mischief was often inspiration enough for these louts. The taking of Bree and the Shire was easy work.

gt: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lo: A man of Dunland, this outlaw was a prized agent of Saruman and a spy for the Witch-king.

gt: Maneuver: Liberate a site you control to make each [MEN] minion strength +2 until the regroup phase. Regroup: Exert Ted Sandyman to stack a [MEN] Man in play on a possession.
lo: "'You can't touch me. I'm a friend o' Boss's. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth.'"

gt: Spot Grima to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use his or her game text until the regroup phase.
lo: "This order does not come from me. It comes from the king. He signed it this morning."

gt: Bearer must be a follower. At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot a [MEN] Man, the Free Peoples player must exert an unbound companion.
lo: "My lord, Gandalf the Grey is coming. He's a herald of woe."

gt: While you can spot an [ORC] minion and fewer minions than companions, each companion loses all defender bonuses and cannot gain defender bonuses. Maneuver: Spot 2 [ORC] minions to make the fellowship's current site gain battleground until the regroup phase.
lo: "They come with fire, they come with axes. Gnawing, biting, breaking, hacking, burning!"

gt: Spot an [ORC] archer minion to add 2 to the minion archery total. If you do, you may add an additional 2 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.
lo: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.

gt: Each the fellowship and minion archery totals are +3. Regroup: Remove (2) to play an [ORC] minion from your discard pile. That minion comes into play exhausted.
lo: "Fear. The city is rank with it."

gt: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc with strength 9 or less (or bearer must be Gothmog). Bearer is fierce. While bearer is Gothmog, he is damage +1 in fierce skirmishes.

To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Each time the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to search the Free Peoples player's draw deck and choose 2 Free Peoples cards found there. Remove those cards from the game.
lo: "Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond!"

gt: Make a companion skirmishing an [ORC] minion strength -2 (or -3 if he or she is an archer).
lo: They dined on the flesh of all that lived and breathed in Middle-earth.

gt: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lo: Crude blood rusted steel axes were dragged by Orcs from battle to battle.

gt: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lo: Enraged by Sauron, the frenzied Orcs streamed to the battlefields.

gt: To play, spot an [ORC] card. The minion archery total is +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lo: "...the enemy is moving. Sauron's forces are massing in the east..."

gt: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Shadow: Exert this minion to play an [URUK-HAI] hunter at twilight cost -2.
lo: Deep in the Isengard pits, Orcs tended the mud from which the Uruk-hai were pulled from.

gt: While the fellowship is at a battleground or underground site, this minion cannot take wounds in the archery phase.
lo: "'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'"

gt: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This minion is strength +3 for each companion in the dead pile (limit +6).
lo: As the free people of Middle-earth fell, Mordor's strength grew.

gt: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert him twice to wound a companion.
lo: Pain. Pain was part of each Orc's life.

gt: Assignment: Spot another [ORC] Orc to assign this minion to skirmish a non-[SHIRE] Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard this minion.
lo: The Orcs attacked the Alliance, rushing across the field that separated the armies.

gt: Remove a threat to reinforce an [ORC] token.
lo: "The old world will burn in the fires of industry. The forests will fall. A new order will rise. We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear and the iron fists of the Orc. We have only to remove those who oppose us."

gt: This minion is strength +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lo: "War is brewing. The mountains are fair teeming with goblins."

gt: Each time you play a [ROHAN] possession from hand, add a [ROHAN] token here. Skirmish: Remove 3 [ROHAN] tokens from here to make a [ROHAN] companion strength +1 and damage +1.
lo: "Your leechcraft would have had me crawling on all fours like a beast!"

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Archery: If bearer is Eomer, exert him to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lo: The short bows of Rohan brought down many a foe on the fields of battle.

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Erkenbrand, you may add (2) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving him. Response: If a [ROHAN] Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.
If the fellowship is at a plains site, exert a [ROHAN] companion to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lo: "This is not a defeat. We will return."

gt: Valiant. Skirmish: Transfer a [ROHAN] possession that Gamling can bear to him.
lo: "Summon every able-bodied man to Dunharrow."

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man or Merry. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4. If bearer is Gamling, you may also spot another companion to make him or her strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lo: "Sound the charge! Take them head-on!"

gt: Discard a [ROHAN] possession from play to choose one: Wound an unwounded minion; exert a minion; or discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing.
lo: Éomer's spear, now thrown, brought down the Haradrim leader.

gt: To play, spot Theoden. Skirmish: Spot a [ROHAN] Man bearing a possession and discard a [ROHAN] possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lo: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.

gt: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] token, this companion is strength +2.
lo: Even the older men of Rohan had talents in the arts of war.

gt: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a [ROHAN] companion to discard a possession a character is bearing from play. Skirmish: Add (1) to transfer a [ROHAN] possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.
lo: "I cannot allow you before Théoden-King so armed."

gt: While you can spot Gandalf, Theoden is resistance +2. While you can spot Eomer, Theoden is damage +1. While you can spot 3 mounted [ROHAN] companions, Theoden is strength +2.
lo: "Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!"

gt: Tale. To play, spot a Hobbit. Maneuver: Discard a tale from play to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lo: "If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved. All I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door."

gt: While the fellowship is in region 1 and you can spot 2 other [SHIRE] companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.
lo: "'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'"

gt: Each time a [SHIRE] companion wins a skimish, you may add a [SHIRE] token here. Fellowship: Remove a [SHIRE] token here to remove a burden.
lo: "'The best beer in the Eastfarthing, or used to be: it is a long time since I tasted it.'"

gt: Remove 2 [SHIRE] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lo: "As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden he knew that he must run for it, or perish. And run he did, out of the back door, through the garden, and over the fields."

gt: At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a [SHIRE] companion. Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: "We are sitting on the field of victory, enjoying a few well-earned comforts."

gt: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you attach this follower to a [SHIRE] companion, you may discard X cards from hand to draw X cards.

Tale. When there are 4 [SHIRE] tokens here, discard this condition from play. Response: If a [SHIRE] condition or [SHIRE] possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a [SHIRE] token here to prevent that.
Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo. Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.
lo: "My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!"

gt: Regroup: Exert an [URUK-HAI] hunter twice to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Archery: Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to transfer this condition from your support area to a Free Peoples archer.
Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.
lo: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.

gt: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose one: discard a follower from play; heal an [URUK-HAI] minion; or control a site.
lo: "What can men do against such reckless hate?"

gt: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2 and damage +1.
lo: That force of ten-thousand Uruk-hai was designed for the downfall of Man - and all those that allied with them.

gt: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Lurtz twice to assign it to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may exert that companion or add a burden to prevent this.
Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. When you play this possession on Lurtz, you may draw a card. Archery: If bearer is Lurtz, discard 2 [URUK-HAI] cards from hand to exert an unbound companion.
lo: The bow of the Uruk captain dealt a powerful blow.

gt: Exert an [URUK-HAI] minion to reinforce an [URUK-HAI] token.
lo: "'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'"

gt: Each [URUK-HAI] minion bearing a hand weapon cannot take wounds during the archery phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make an [URUK-HAI] minion bearing a possession strength +2.
lo: Many a crude weapon was forged for his forces.

gt: Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lo: "I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!"

gt: While you can spot 3 [URUK-HAI] hunters, at the start of each skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] hunter, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
lo: Though bred for battle, the Uruks could track prey like the best of hunters.

gt: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lo: The Uruk-hai army stopped and growled in anticipation of the upcoming battle.

gt: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may heal an [URUK-HAI] minion.
lo: "March to Helms Deep! Leave none alive!"

gt: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each other [URUK-HAI] minion you can spot.
lo: The enormous Uruk-hai armies marched with great speed.

gt: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may control a site.
lo: The Men and Elves looked out into the darkness, and through the rain they saw, lit by the thousands of torches, the huge advancing Uruk-hai army.

gt: Damage +1. Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound.
lo: The Uruk-hai... resilient... imposing...

gt: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion and you must control a site.
lo: The flood of Uruk-hai storming the Deeping Wall seemed to be unstoppable.

gt: Damage +1. Skirmish: Spot 2 other [URUK-HAI] minions and remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 and damage +1.
lo: The Uruk-hai troop snuck along through the forest following the three boats carrying the Fellowship.

gt: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion.
To play, spot a Nazgul. Remove (X) to choose one: discard a follower from play that has a twilight cost of X; or play from deck a [WRAITH] minion that has a twilight cost of X.
lo: "A sudden unreasoning fear of discovery laid hold of Frodo, and he thought of his Ring."

gt: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a [WRAITH] minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a [WRAITH] minion lose fierce and gain hunter 2 until the regroup phase.
lo: "I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!"

gt: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of his characters.
Mountain. Each card that is about to be placed into the discard pile is removed from the game instead.
River. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player heals each of his or her characters.
Battleground. Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may reinforce a culture token.
River.
Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.
Dwelling. While the fellowship is at this site, followers cannot be transfered to a character.

While wearing The One Ring, each time the bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead. Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.
Damage +1. Fellowship. Each time you play a [DWARVEN] possession, you may draw a card.
lo: “If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.”

gt: Bearer must be a [DWARVEN] companion. Bearer gains Hunter 2. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [DWARVEN] companion. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.
Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.
lo: “Legolas, two already!”

gt: Bearer must be an [ELVEN] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [ELVEN] companion. At the start of the archery phase, you must exert bearer or return this condition to hand.
Ranger. While you can spot 2 [ELVEN] followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2. Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.
lo: “I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.”

gt: Archer. Fellowship. Archery: Add two threats to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: “Have you heard nothing Lord Elrond has said? The Ring must be destroyed!”

gt: Fellowship. Response: If an event is played, exert Gandalf twice to cancel that event.
lo: “The Ring yearns above all else to return to the hand of its master. They are one, the Ring and the Dark Lord. Frodo, he must never find it.”

gt: To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another companion. At the end of each turn, return this condition to hand.
Gollum is strength +1 for each threat you can spot. Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lo: “‘But if we was master, then we could help ourselfs, yes...'”

gt: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, you may shuffle up to 2 [GOLLUM] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck. Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound companion to make Smeagol strength +2.
lo: “...now that I see him, I do pity him.”

gt: Fellowship. Ranger. While the Ring-bearer is the only other companion you can spot, Aragorn is an archer, defender +1, and can take no more than 1 wound each skirmish.
lo: “The skill of the Elves can reforge the sword of Kings, but only you have the power to wield it.”

gt: Fellowship. Ranger. While you can spot two unbound Hobbits, Boromir's twilight cost is -1. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may exert an unbound Hobbit to discard each minion he is skirmishing from play.
lo: “In a dream, I saw the eastern sky grow dark.”

gt: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [GONDOR] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer is not Aragorn, return this condition to hand.
lo: “Your time will come. You will face the same evil...”

gt: Bearer must be a fellowship companion. While bearer is a [GONDOR] companion, he or she is damage +1.
lo: “I would have followed you my Brother... my Captain... my King!”

gt: When you play Grima, you may remove (4) to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Grima to assign him to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.
Weather. Each time the fellowship moves, add (2) for each Ent you can spot. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a non-[WRAITH] minion strength +1.
lo: “If the mountain defeats you, will you risk a more dangerous road?”

gt: Damage +2. Fierce. While at an underground site, skip the archery phase, the maneuver phase, and The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions of strength 6 or less.
lo: “The flames roared up to greet it, and wreathed about it...”

gt: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you spot.
lo: “Frodo felt something seize him by the ankle...”

gt: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you spot.
lo: “One came wriggling over the threshold...”

gt: Discard all other minions (except tentacles). Watcher in the Water cannot bear possessions. The fellowship's current site gains marsh. Shadow: Play a tentacle from your discard pile.
lo: “...as if a host of snakes were swimming up...”

gt: Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. When you play this minion, add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
lo: Black blood. Flat feet. Scaly skin

gt: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make an [ORC] minion strength +2.
lo: Stones to move. Bridges to be rebuilt.

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [ROHAN] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.
lo: “Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!”

gt: Valiant. Eomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
lo: “Now is the hour, Riders of Rohan, oaths you have taken! Now, fulfill them all! To Lord and Land!”

gt: Valiant. Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] companion with a twilight cost of 3 or more; his or her twilight cost is -1.
lo: “It's tradition for the women of the court to farewell the men.”

gt: Remove a Free Peoples culture token to add a threat. When you play this event, you may remove (1) to place this on the bottom of your draw deck instead of in your discard pile.
lo: “One by one, the free lands of Middle-earth fell to the power of the Ring.”

gt: Fellowship. Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. While you cannot spot 4 threats, Shadow cards cannot discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
lo: “We're friends of Gandalf the Grey.”

gt: Fellowship. Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, take 2 [SHIRE] cards from your discard pile and remove them from the game to make a companion strength +2.
lo: “You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin - to the bitter end.'”

gt: Fellowship. Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot.
lo: “‘You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'”

gt: Bearer must be a [SHIRE] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to a fellowship companion. Each time this condition is transferred to a companion, heal that companion.
Fellowship. Ring-bound. While Sam bears The One Ring, he is resistance -4. While you can spot 3 [SHIRE] companions, Sam is strength +2. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer.
Archer. Damage +1. Response: If Lurtz is about to take a wound or be exerted, remove (2) (or exert another Uruk-hai) to prevent that wound or exertion.
lo: The Uruk-hai leader walked into view on the misty hilltop beneath the dark trees. Hungry for blood.

gt: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] minion. When you play this, you may draw a card. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [WRAITH] minion.
lo: The Nazgûl's true forms were revealed to him, shining like ghostly Kings.

gt: Fierce. While you can spot 5 twilight tokens in the twilight pool and another [WRAITH] card, Ulaire Attea is strength +3.
lo: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the will of Sauron.

gt: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and discard a Nazgul from hand to wound an unbound companion.
lo: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

gt: Fierce. Ulaire Lemenya is strength +1 for each [WRAITH] possession in your discard pile.
lo: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

gt: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Nertea, name a race. The Free Peoples player cannot assign Ulaire Nertea to skirmish a companion of the named race.
lo: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

gt: Fierce. Ulaire Toldea cannot be assigned to skirmish the same companion in a fierce skirmish that he has already been assigned to this turn.
lo: “‘Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

gt: Fierce. Skirmish: Discard a Nazgul from hand to make The Witch-king strength +1 (or strength +2 if you can spot that discarded Nazgul).
lo: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

gt: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.  Discard a Shadow item borne by a minion that Dwarf is skirmishing.
lo: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf.
lo: Dwarves from Dáin's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.

gt: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a minion loses a skirmish to bearer, you may make a minion strength -1 until the regroup phase. The Shadow player may discard 2 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: “‘Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'”

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.
lo: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.

gt: Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) and place a card from hand beneath your draw deck to draw a card.
lo: “Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.”

gt: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to make Gimli unable to take wounds.
lo: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.

gt: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. The first time your opponent plays an Orc each turn, you may take a [DWARVEN] card into hand from your discard pile. The Shadow player may discard the bottom 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: “‘With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'”

gt: Skirmish: Spot a [DWARVEN] companion and exert Grimir twice to play a [DWARVEN] skirmish event from your discard pile, then remove it from the game.
lo: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.

gt: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, discard a Shadow card. Its owner may discard 3 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: “‘My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'”

gt: Tale. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may discard a card from hand to heal that Dwarf.
lo: “When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....”

gt: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, you may heal an Elf; any shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
lo: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

gt: Exert an Elf to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Make the fellowship archery total +X until the regroup phase, where X is the number of Orcs revealed. That player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'”

gt: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond twice (or once if you can spot 2 other [Elven] allies) to draw a card.
lo: “He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, draw a card. Any Shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
lo: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.

gt: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. If an [isengard] minion was revealed, you may draw 2 cards.
lo: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.

gt: At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf; that Elf's twilight cost is -1.
lo: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at a forest or river (or any site 6, 7, or 8), he is strength +2 and an archer.
lo: “‘But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'”

gt: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion. Exert him again unless he bears a ranged weapon or you can spot more minions than companions.
lo: “‘And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. ‘It would be faithless now to say farewell.'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf.
lo: “‘...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert Galadriel to reveal 3 cards at random from an opponent's hand.  Place one on top of that player's draw deck.
lo: “‘What you will see I cannot tell....'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.
lo: “‘May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound a [SAURON] minion twice or discard a [SAURON] condition or possession.
lo: “‘What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy...?'”

gt: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to exert a minion. An opponent may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
lo: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.

gt: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a spell into hand from your discard pile.
lo: “‘You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. ‘He is wise enough on his own ground.'”

gt: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar and discard a card from hand to draw a card.
lo: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.

gt: Spell. Exert Gandalf to discard a Shadow condition and then hinder all other conditions.
lo: “‘Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'”

gt: Play a Wizard or [GANDALF] ally from your draw deck.
lo: “‘A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'”

gt: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
lo: “Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

gt: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition. Response: If a skirmish event or special ability is used during a skirmish involving Boromir, discard this to prevent that.
lo: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”

gt: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lo: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.

gt: Bearer must be a Man or [GONDOR] companion. The minion archery total is -1.
lo: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.

gt: Stealth. Bearer must be a ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.
lo: “‘Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. ‘My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'”

gt: If a skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [GONDOR] companion, cancel that event.
lo: “‘Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'”

gt: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Do not stop until they are found!'”

gt: Spell. Exert an [isengard] minion to discard a Free Peoples condition and then hinder all other conditions.
lo: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.

gt: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. No player may play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving an [ISENGARD] minion at this site. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lo: Saruman's spells can hinder even the wary.

gt: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2. If you can spot 5 companions, also make it fierce and an additional strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lo: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.

gt: Search. To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Regroup: Spot 4 [isengard] minions, an exhausted Ring-bearer, or 5 burdens to make the move limit for this turn -1 (limit once per phase).
lo: “‘In all the long wars with the Dark Tower treason has ever been our greatest foe.'”

gt: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.
lo: A bloodthirsty bellow from a huge Uruk can win a skirmish before it begins.

gt: Damage +1. Maneuver: Remove (2) to heal an [ISENGARD] minion.
lo: Uruk shamans know the arts of healing as well as those of battle.

gt: Damage +1. When you play this minion, exert a companion. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.

gt: Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1. Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [ISENGARD] possession from your discard pile. Response: If your [ISENGARD] minion is about to take a wound, remove (1) and discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lo: The ranks of Saruman's army include forgers of weapons and armour.

gt: Damage +1. While you can spot 2 Uruk-hai, each Uruk-hai is strength +1. While you can spot 4 Uruk-hai, this minion is fierce.
lo: “‘Imagine, Gandalf, an army – born from the earth of Isengard.'”

gt: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck.
lo: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.

gt: Choose one: make a [moria] minion strength +2, or make a [moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [moria] minion you can spot (limit +5).
lo: “...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

gt: Archer. The fellowship archery total is -1 for each [moria] archer you can spot. Assignment: Exert this minion to prevent [moria] archers from being assigned to skirmishes.
lo: “An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.”

gt: Shadow: Exert this minion or a unique [MORIA] Orc to draw a card.
lo: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”

gt: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [MORIA] possession from your discard pile.
lo: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

gt: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

gt: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lo: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

gt: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play a unique [RINGWRAITH] minion from your discard pile.
lo: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

gt: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may remove (2) to add 2 burdens. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.
lo: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.

gt: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to take a [SAURON] card into hand from your discard pile. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 8 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: “‘Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

gt: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] minion to add (1) for each [SAURON] Orc you can spot (limit (3)).
lo: “‘....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. The Ring-bearer is strength +1 for each burden you can spot. If you cannot spot another companion, the Ring-bearer is resistance -2 for each burden you can spot.
lo: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] minion. Plays on an archer companion. Each time the Free Peoples player uses an archery special ability, bearer must exert.
lo: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

gt: Search. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1). When you can no longer spot 7 companions or this card leaves play, this penalty is immediately lost.
lo: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

gt: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, then for each card in the dead pile the Free Peoples player must choose to add a burden or discard 4 cards from the top of their draw deck.
lo: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

gt: When you play this minion, you may draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.
lo: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

gt: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.
lo: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a [GONDOR] companion.  Limit 1 per bearer.  While you can spot 2 tales, bearer is strength -2.
lo: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

gt: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Merry to make him strength +1 for each hand weapon you can spot (limit +3).
lo: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Sam to take a [SHIRE] item into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

gt: Fellowship: Exert Sam and another companion to remove a burden. Then, exert Sam again unless you can spot 2 [SHIRE] allies (or Rosie Cotton). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lo: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

gt: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (2)).
lo: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

t: A Talent for Not Being Seen
gt: Stealth. Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Limit 1 per character. Each site's Shadow number is -1.
lo: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

gt: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character (except an enduring character), to make it strength +2.
Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard a card from hand.
While you can spot more companions than minions, [ISENGARD] minions are twilight cost -1 for each [ISENGARD] minion you can spot.
Tale. Fellowship: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to play a [DWARVEN] weapon from your discard pile. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck.
lo: “‘There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; / The delver mined, the mason built.'”

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Fror is strength +3.
lo: “It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.”

gt: For each [DWARVEN] tale you can spot, Gloin is strength +1 (limit +4).
lo: “‘But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf and hinder an item borne by that Dwarf to hinder a Shadow condition (if that condition is a weather or borne by a Dwarf, discard it instead).
lo: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

gt: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3). You may then discard up to 30 cards from your draw deck 3 at a time.
lo: “‘There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'”

gt: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (and hinder another Shadow condition if you can spot an Orc).
lo: “‘Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'”

gt: Bearer must be a ranger. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Make bearer strength +2 and damage +1 while bearing this item and skirmishing a Nazgul until the regroup phase (limit once per turn). Discard this possession at the start of the regroup phase.
lo: “...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.”

gt: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons. Skirmish: If bearer is Boromir, discard this to make him take no wounds.
lo: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.

gt: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard a Free Peoples armor, helm, or shield. Hinder up to 4 Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions or 8 [ISENGARD] cards.
lo: “‘Whom do you serve?'”

gt: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Each time an ally exerts, add (1) (or (2) if that ally is [shire]).
lo: “In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville-Bagginses arrived.”

gt: Bearer must be a unique Uruk-hai. If bearer is Lurtz, he is damage +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.
lo: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.

gt: While you can spot an [ISENGARD] minion, this card is twilight cost -3. The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.
lo: “‘Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'”

gt: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [ISENGARD] minion to take a minion into hand from your draw deck. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 5 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
lo: “‘A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'”

gt: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert a unique Uruk-hai to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.
lo: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.

gt: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] card from your discard pile.
lo: “‘Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'”

gt: Nazgul are not roaming. While you can spot a Hobbit, the Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
lo: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

gt: Bearer's special abilities cannot be used. Maneuver: If this is in your support area, exert a Nazgul to transfer this to a Ring-bound companion.
lo: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

gt: Twilight. Return to Its Master cannot be played. Skirmishes involving The Witch-king cannot be canceled. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
lo: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

gt: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to add a burden for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player may discard their hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

gt: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice (except the Ring-bearer) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
lo: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.

gt: Fellowship: Exert Merry to take a Hobbit ally into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn).
lo: “‘Ow... I think I've broken somehing.'”

gt: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Fellowship: Discard this condition to make each Nazgul strength -4 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'”

gt: Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make the Ring-bearer strength +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul or to take off The One Ring.
lo: “With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.”

gt: Each time you play a companion, you may play an item on them from your discard pile (at twilight cost -2 if that companion is Gandalf or Aragorn).
lo: “Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quite forgetful of their danger.”

gt: Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -1.  While the fellowship is at an underground site, Gimli is strength +1.
lo: “‘In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [DWARVEN] companion to heal a [DWARVEN] ally. Skirmish: Exert a [DWARVEN] ally to add that ally's strength or damage bonuses to an unbound [DWARVEN] companion (limit once per phase). Regroup: Exert a [DWARVEN] ally to heal a [DWARVEN] companion.
lo: “‘There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'”

gt: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +1. Fellowship: Discard this condition to hinder a Shadow condition (or discard up to 2 [moria] conditions).
lo: “No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....”

gt: Ranger. Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard X cards from hand to prevent that wound, where X is the current region number.
lo: “‘If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'”

gt: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -1 for each home 3 [ELVEN] ally you can spot (limit -4).
lo: “Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 to heal that ally up to 2 times. Add (1) per wound healed. Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
lo: “Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] or [ringwraith] card, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
lo: “‘Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'”

gt: At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another Elf. Each time the fellowship is about to move to an opponent's site during the Fellowship phase, you may exert Galadriel to replace that site with a forest of the same site number from your adventure deck.
lo: “‘There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an Orc).
lo: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.

gt: To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Bearer's resistance is +2.
lo: “‘May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'”

gt: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an Uruk-hai).
lo: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.

gt: Bearer must be Elrond. Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice to hinder a Shadow condition.
lo: “Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.”

gt: Spell. Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard a Shadow condition and hinder all other Shadow conditions.
