lo: “He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....”

gt: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (1).
lo: “‘...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'”

gt: Tale. Archery: Exert a [GONDOR] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lo: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

gt: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and discard this possession to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lo: “On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....”

t: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
gt: Bearer must be a companion or ally. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish against an [ISENGARD] minion, add a burden. At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may exert bearer twice to discard this condition.
Spot an Uruk-hai and an Orc to draw 3 cards.
lo: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

gt: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [ISENGARD] card from hand to add (3) (or (5) if that card was an Orc).
lo: “‘Rip them all down!'”

gt: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 4 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lo: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.

gt: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an [isengard] minion. The Free Peoples player may place any number of cards from hand on top of their draw deck, then reveals their hand. For each Free Peoples card revealed, make that minion strength +1 until the regroup phase. Limit once per phase.
lo: “‘Seven stars and seven stones....'”

gt: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Maneuver: Exert Saruman to make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase. Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, discard (or exert) Saruman to prevent that wound.
Skirmish: Make an [ISENGARD] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if that Orc is strength 7 or less).
lo: “‘This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Each character skirmishing an [ISENGARD] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons. Skirmish: Spot a skirmishing [ISENGARD] Orc. Make the Free Peoples shuffle another [ISENGARD] Orc into your draw deck to cancel the active skirmish.
lo: “‘...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'”

gt: Tracker. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and damage +1. Each time an ally exerts, you may spot another [isengard] card and exert this minion to wound that ally.
lo: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.

gt: Spot a [MORIA] Orc and a [SAURON] Orc to play up to 2 [SAURON] or [MORIA] items from your discard pile. Wound a Free Peoples archer for each item played.
lo: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.

gt: Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer and a [MORIA] minion, discard a possession borne by bearer. The Free Peoples player may exert bearer or discard another Free Peoples item to prevent that.
lo: “‘Boromir... give the Ring to Frodo.'”

gt: Choose one: exert an [ISENGARD] minion to make a Nazgul damage +1 until the regroup phase, or exert a Nazgul to make an [ISENGARD] minion unable to take wounds until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'”

gt: To play, exert a [ringwraith] minion. Bearer must be a companion or ally (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer is exerted by a Free Peoples card, exert bearer unless the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand of bearer's culture.
lo: “His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. ‘Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'”

gt: Exert a [SAURON] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. You may take a minion into hand from your draw deck costing up to X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed. The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘A power was there that we have not felt before.'”

gt: Search. Spot a [SAURON] card and a Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each burden you can spot. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 to prevent this.
lo: “‘The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'”

gt: Exert a unique [SAURON] minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer) and discard a possession attached to that companion. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from their hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘The power of the Ring could not be undone.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Discard a [SAURON] minion to reveal the top 2 cards of your opponent's draw deck. If at least 1 is a Free Peoples card, exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Your opponent may discard all revealed Free Peoples cards to prevent this.
lo: “‘Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'”

gt: To play, discard a [SAURON] minion. Return up to X [SAURON] minions to hand, where X is the number of races you can spot in the fellowship. The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
lo: “‘The power of the Black Land grows....'”

gt: If a companion or ally's special ability is used, you may spot a [SAURON] card to wound that character. The Free Peoples player may discard another companion to prevent this.
lo: “‘In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'”

gt: To play, exert a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves, draw 2 cards. The Free Peoples player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
lo: “The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....”

gt: Stealth. Bearer must be Sam. Each site's Shadow number is -1. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
lo: “‘That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'”

gt: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
lo: “‘I think I'm getting the hang of this!'”

gt: To play, spot 2 [SHIRE] companions. Plays to your support area. Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal up to 2 companions (limit once per phase).
lo: “‘Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'”

gt: Shadow: Heal a companion to play an [ISENGARD] Orc from your discard pile.

Tale. When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to discard the top 5 cards of your draw deck.
Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make that Dwarf unable to take wounds.
lo: “‘It's a bit tight around the chest.'”

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Erethon bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +1 and damage +1, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: At close range, Erethón's accuracy is uncanny.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Fereveldir and discard an [ELVEN] token from your condition to wound a minion Fereveldir is skirmishing.
lo: Thandronen's sons patrol the borders of Lórien together.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Ferevellon to make a minion skirmishing him strength -2.
lo: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.

gt: Valiant. While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2. Regroup: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.
lo: “‘In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor – we come to honor that allegiance.'”

gt: Archer. Each time a Shadow event or Shadow condition is played, remove (1) for each unbound Hobbit you can spot (limit (2)).
lo: “‘They are far, far away.... I know in my heart that they have not rested this night.'”

gt: Valiant. Regroup: Exert this companion to make a Shadow player wound a minion.
lo: Haldir's Elven bowmen were experienced defenders of the borders of the Golden Wood

gt: Valiant. Each minion skirmishing this companion is strength -2 for each wound on that minion.
lo: Long, curved Elven steel cut down Uruks already weakened by Elven arrows.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. The twilight cost of each ranged weapon played on Ordulus is -1.
lo: Ordulus always has an arrow nocked and a full quiver too.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Pengedhel bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +2 and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: Pengedhel can wield an arrow like a short spear.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Thandronen to discard a minion stacked on a condition or stacked on a site.
lo: The twin sons of Thandronen marched with their father to defend Helm's Deep.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Thonnas bears a ranged weapon, each minion skirmishing him is strength -2 and Thonnas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: Elves of Lórien hone their knife-work fighting Goblin raiders.

gt: Spell. If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, spot Gandalf to hinder all conditions. Add (1) for each Shadow condition hindered (limit (5)).
lo: “His hood and grey rags were flung away. His white garments shone.”

gt: Skirmish: Spot Gandalf and 3 twilight tokens to make a companion who has the Gandalf signet unable to take wounds.
lo: “‘A witless worm you have become.'”

gt: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make him unable to take wounds. Any Shadow player may make you wound a minion to prevent this.
lo: “‘His fire was about me. I was burned.'”

gt: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or hinder a Shadow artifact.
lo: “‘I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: If you can spot an [ISENGARD] minion, spot a fortification. Make the Free Peoples player distribute X + 1 wounds among your [ISENGARD] minions, where X is its twilight cost. Discard that fortification. Archery: Spot 2 [ISENGARD] archers to make allies take wounds from archery fire instead of companions.
lo: “‘We are the fighting Uruk-hai.... Bring out your skulking king!'”

gt: Lurker. Each unbound companion or ally bearing a Shadow condition is strength -1.
lo: “‘Did I not counsel you, lord, to forbid his staff?'”

gt: Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a weapon borne by an unbound companion (or all Free Peoples cards borne by that companion if they are bearing 3 or more cards).
lo: “‘I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.'”

gt: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to play an Uruk-hai; its twilight cost is -1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot (limit -2).
lo: “‘We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm.'”

gt: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.
lo: “‘They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'”

gt: Plays to your support area. Fortification. Each time a [ROHAN] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [ROHAN] token on this card. Regroup: Discard a Shadow condition for each [ROHAN] token here (limit 4). Discard this condition.
lo: “‘...it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'”

gt: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1.
lo: “‘Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'”

gt: Spot 2 [ROHAN] Men (or 1 valiant [ROHAN] Man) to play a [ROHAN] character or [ROHAN] item from your draw deck.
lo: “‘How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called... for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'”

gt: Fellowship: Spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits (or Smeagol) and add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).
lo: “‘The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

gt: At the start of each skirmish, you may exert your character in that skirmish to prevent special abilities being used.
Damage +1. Valiant. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion assigned to skirmish an unbound companion.
lo: Despite Théoden's preparations, Gimli found it necessary to warn him of the advancing Uruk army.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While skirmishing a wounded minion, Balglin takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
lo: He is a strong fighter. He asks for no quarter and gives none.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Taurnil bears a ranged weapon, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +2, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: Taurnil's careful aim can disarm his enemies at long range.

gt: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage +1.
Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a condition borne by an unbound companion (or hinder a companion and all Free Peoples cards they bear if you can spot 4 Free Peoples cultures).
lo: “‘I care for you and yours as best I may.... Let others deal with these irksome guests.'”

gt: Machine. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [ISENGARD] token here (limit 2 per phase). Skirmish: For each [ISENGARD] token here, heal an Uruk-hai. Discard this condition.
lo: “Hundreds of long ladders were lifted up. Many were cast down in ruin, but many more replaced them....”

gt: Spot 3 valiant companions to discard up to 2 conditions and liberate a site.
lo: “‘Let us drive through such foes as are already between us and the fastness.'”

gt: Spot 3 valiant companions to make one of those companions defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lo: “‘We must draw all our forces now behind the walls.'”

gt: Villager. Regroup: Exert Sigewulf and spot 5 valiant companions to discard a minion.
lo: The courage of Sigewulf and other Rohirrim like him will not be forgotten.

gt: Archer. Valiant. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.
lo: “‘...even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'”

t: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
gt: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, hinder all conditions.
lo: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.

gt: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card. If that minion is now 4 strength or less, discard the revealed card.
lo: “‘Give them a volley.'”

gt: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.
lo: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.

gt: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lo: “‘But do not think that only by singing amid the trees... is Lothlórien maintained and defended....'”

gt: Spot Gandalf and discard X cards from hand to make an opponent choose to discard X Shadow conditions or make you hinder X Shadow conditions.
lo: “‘There never was much hope....'”

gt: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to Gandalf.' At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

Spot any number of [gollum] conditions. Make Smeagol strength +3 and damage +1 for each condition spotted. Discard each of your spotted conditions and hinder each of your opponent's spotted conditions.
lo: “‘Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'”

gt: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is strength +2 for each minion he is skirmishing. Assignment: Add a threat to make Aragorn defender +1 (limit +1).
lo: "The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... for Aragorn son of Arathorn was going to war upon the marches of Morder."

gt: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2. Fellowship: Exert Cirion to play a beacon from your draw deck (limit once per turn).
lo: “So now at last the City was besieged...”

gt: Ranger. Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] Man to heal Faramir. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make Faramir unable to take wounds.
Knight. Maneuver: Discard a fortification to remove a threat.
When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgul to add a threat. The Free Peoples player may make you wound a companion to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +3.
Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1. Response: If Theoden is about to take a wound and you cannot spot 3 threats, add 2 threats to prevent that wound.
Bearer must be Merry. Maneuver: Exert Merry X times to exert a minion once for each [ROHAN] companion you spot (limit X).
Exert X mounted companions to wound X minions and remove X burdens.
lo: “...for the joy of battle was on them, and the sound of their singing that was fair and terrible came even to the City.”

gt: Fellowship: Exert a [ROHAN] Man to make the twilight cost of each Shadow condition and possession +2 until the regroup phase.
Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens (limit once per phase).
While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard this condition to draw a card.
lo: “‘Certainty of death, small chance of success....'”

gt: If the fellowship moves, spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf to make an opponent hinder X Shadow cards.
lo: “...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.”

gt: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to X cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck, where X is the current region number +1.
lo: “‘...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'”

gt: Each time a companion skirmishing a [GOLLUM] minion takes a wound, exert a companion.
lo: “‘And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back!”

gt: Enduring. To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Wraiths and add 2 threats. While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.
lo: “...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....”

gt: Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. While you have initiative, exhausted [GONDOR] Wraiths cannot take wounds. Response: If a Shadow card is about to discard this condition, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that.
lo: “‘And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'”

gt: Corsair. Enduring. While in region 2 or 3, this minion is fierce. Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to reinforce a [RAIDER] card twice.
lo: “‘They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'”

gt: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may choose 1: discard a Shadow possession to reinforce a [RAIDER] token twice; or remove 2 [RAIDER] tokens to discard a possession.
lo: “Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....”

gt: When you play this possession, you may add a [RAIDER] token here. While you can spot 6 [RAIDER] tokens and a [RAIDER] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand. Regroup: Add (1) for each [RAIDER] token you can spot. Discard this possession.
To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] companions. You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event. When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.
lo: “‘Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion!'”

gt: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [SAURON] engine you can spot (limit -5). When you play this minion at any site 5 or higher, you may discard an engine to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lo: “...and soon yet more companies of the enemy were swiftly setting up....”

gt: Engine. Shadow: Play a [SAURON] minion to add a [SAURON] token here. Regroup: Discard a [SAURON] minion and remove X [SAURON] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. If that card is not in the support area, discard this possession.
lo: “...and the black serpent foundered.”

gt: Damage +1. While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.
lo: “‘Never trust an Elf.'”

gt: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [ELVEN] companion you can spot.
lo: “‘...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!...Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'”

gt: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgul he is skirmishing strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
The move limit is +1. When Radagast leaves play, this bonus is immediately lost. Each time the fellowship moves, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.
lo: “‘...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'”

gt: Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing your Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile. Fellowship: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).
lo: “‘The Sun shines through you.'”

gt: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile. Regroup: If Smeagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.
lo: “‘...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'”

gt: While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or wound him twice. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.
lo: “‘True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....’”

gt: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Regroup: Discard a [GONDOR] artifact borne by a companion to liberate a site.
lo: “...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

gt: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions. While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [GONDOR] knight is strength +1.
lo: “‘“But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.”'”

gt: To play, spot an unbound [GONDOR] Man. Response: If a [GONDOR] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that wound and heal that Man.
lo: “‘Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'”

gt: Fellowship: Discard this and exert a Man to take a Free Peoples Man of a different culture into hand from your draw deck. Regroup: Exert 2 of your Men to discard a Man from your dead pile. Remove this artifact from the game.
lo: “‘The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'”

gt: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [SHIRE] tale.
lo: “‘But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'”

gt: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [DWARVEN] condition or [DWARVEN] possession from hand.
lo: “‘Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'”

gt: To play, spot 2 Elves. Skirmish: Exert Cirdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [ELVEN] event in your discard pile. If that minion is overwhelmed, remove half of the [ELVEN] events in your discard pile from the game.
lo: “...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....”

gt: When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3. Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [elven] event from hand to hinder a Shadow condition or possession.
lo: “‘I pass the test,' she said. ‘I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'”

gt: To play, spot 2 Elves. When you lose initiative, you may make a minion strength -3 until the regroup phase (limit once per turn).
lo: “‘The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'”

gt: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard X times to hinder X minions.
lo: “...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....”

gt: Any site 9 is a mountain. Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile (limit once per phase). Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.
lo: “The fires below awoke in anger....”

gt: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [gondor] item or condition into hand from your draw deck. Choose an opponent who may draw a card.
lo: “There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....”

gt: Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [RAIDER] Man to reconcile your hand (limit once per phase). At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [RAIDER] Man strength +2.
lo: “‘I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'”

gt: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Enquea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: If Ulaire Enquea is skirmishing, remove (1) and heal him to add a burden.
lo: “Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.”

gt: Skirmish: Exert Eowyn to make an opponent wound or hinder a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Eowyn.
lo: “‘Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'”

gt: When you play this minion, if you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).
lo: “The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....”

gt: To play, exert a [GANDALF] Wizard. Discard a card from hand to take a Shadow card from your discard pile into hand.
lo: "Gandalf lifted it carefully, but the leaves crackled and broke as he laid it on the slab."

gt: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert this minion to transfer a possession or condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.
lo: “The strangers, especially those that had come up the Greenway, stared at them curiously.”

gt: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may add (1) (or (2) if you can spot 6 companions).
lo: “But soon there were few left in Minas Tirith who had the heart to stand up and defy the hosts of Mordor.”

gt: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [ORC] conditions from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: “‘There is always a smoke rising from Isengard these days.'”

gt: River. The minion archery total is +X for each companion you can spot over 5, where X is the current region number.
At the start of each skirmish, you may exert your character in that skirmish to prevent special abilities being used.
Marsh. When the fellowship moves here in region 1 or 2, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert all others.
Valiant. While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.
lo: “There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.”

gt: Valiant. Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.
lo: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.

gt: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.
Valiant. While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [ELVEN] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.
lo: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.

gt: Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [DWARVEN] Dwarf or hunter [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [ELVEN] Elf strength +2.
lo: “‘...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas...'”

gt: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2. While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.
lo: “‘...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befirend you, as Elrond asked...'”

gt: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to wound a roaming minion twice.
lo: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.

gt: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [GONDOR] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2. At the start of the Maneuver phase, for each threat you can spot, make a minion's site number +1 until the start of the regroup phase.
lo: “‘For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'”

gt: When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [ORC] minions from play to make it strength +10 and fierce until the end of the turn. Shadow: Remove (2) to play an [ORC] Orc from your discard pile. It comes into play exhausted.
lo: “Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.”

gt: Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon takes no more than 1 wound per skirmish. Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1. Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.
lo: “‘...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'”

gt: Valiant. Hunter 1. While this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to heal another hunter.
lo: "We are proud to fight alongside Men, once more"

gt: When you play this, add an [ELVEN] token here for each hunter you can spot (limit 3). Maneuver: Discard this condition (or remove a token from here) and discard a card from hand to discard a condition.
lo: "We shall not meet again, Elessar."

gt: Spell. Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to search a Shadow player's discard pile and choose 2 minions, then return those minions to their owner's hand. If you do, reveal that hand and discard a revealed minion.
lo: "'I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Men or Elves or Orcs...'"

gt: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard. Discard all other possessions and weapons on bearer. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert bearer and add a threat to remove a burden.
lo: "There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."

gt: Valiant. While you can spot an [ELVEN] token, this companion is strength +2.
lo: While they may prefer to avoid conflict, the elves can be ferocious warriors in defense of their ideals.

gt: To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn. While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +1 and resistance +2. Each time you play an [ELVEN] skirmish event, you may exert Galadriel to reinforce an [ELVEN] token.
lo: "Will you look into the mirror?"

gt: To play, spot 2 [ELVEN] companions. Maneuver: Add a threat to take an [ELVEN] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile. Regroup: Remove an [ELVEN] token to take an [ELVEN] condition into hand from your discard pile.
lo: "'...the power of Gil-galad has increased in his absence.'"

gt: Valiant. Skirmish: Exert Haldir or discard a [ELVEN] card from hand to make a minion skirmishing Haldir strength -2.
lo: "I bring word from Elrond of Rivendell."

gt: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Man. While bearer is Grimbeorn, each time he wins a skirmish you may take a [GANDALF] event into hand from your discard pile (limit once per turn).

Maneuver or Skirmish: Restore a Nazgul. Then you may exert The Witch-king twice to hinder all Free Peoples possessions.
lo: "'Yet now under the Lord of Barad-dûr the most fell of all his captains is already master of your outer walls,' said Gandalf. 'King of Angmar long ago, Sorcerer, Ringwraith, Lord of the Nazgûl, a spear of terror in the hand of Sauron, shadow of despair.'"

gt: Lurker. Other minions cannot take more than 1 wound per phase. Response: If a Free Peoples event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lo: "'Take swift counsel with what little wit is left to you. For Sauron does not love spies...'"

gt: If your Nazgul wins a skirmish, exert it to reconcile your hand.  You may discard a Nazgul from hand to wound a companion it was skirmishing.
lo: "A great black shape against the fires beyond he loomed up, grown to a vast menace of despair. In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face."

gt: Fierce. Each time you play a minion from hand, you may exert Ulaire Attea to play another minion with the same twilight cost from your discard pile. Skirmish: Hinder another minion to make Ulaire Attea strength +1.

Fierce. Skirmish: Exert this minion to hinder all possessions and conditions borne by a character it is skirmishing.  If you can spot another Nazgul, hinder all other copies of those cards you can spot.
lo: "'Do you not know Death when you see it? Die now and curse in vain!'"

gt: Fierce. Relentless. (This minion participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce.)At the start of each skirmish involving Ulaire Enquea and a wounded companion or ally, you may exert him to heal that character and exert a companion.
Fierce. Each character skirmishing this minion is strength -1 for each other Nazgul you can spot (or -1 for each other companion you can spot if you can spot 6 companions).
lo: "'The storm is coming. The Nazgûl have crossed the River! Ride, ride! Wait not for the dawn! Let not the swift wait for the slow! Ride!'"

gt: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgul strength +1 for each of your sites on the adventure path (limit +2, or limit +5 if you can spot another Nazgul).
lo: "'Those Nazgûl give me the creeps....But He likes 'em; they're His favourites nowadays.'"

gt: Fierce. Each time you play a minion, you may exert it to play a possession on it from your discard pile (or an artifact if you also exert this minion).
lo: "'And they skin the body off you as soon as look at you, and leave you all cold in the dark on the other side.'"

gt: Fierce. Each time a Nazgul wins a skirmish, you may exert this minion and remove (1) to play a Shadow condition from your discard pile. Add a threat if it is [RINGWRAITH].
lo: "'As their Dark Lord now grew and put forth his strength, so their voices, which uttered only his will and his malice, were filled with evil and horror.'"

gt: Fierce. Each time this minion is assigned to a stronger companion, you may exhaust this minion to hinder that companion. Each time this minion is assigned to a weaker companion, you may exert this minion to exert that companion or add a threat.

Enduring. Damage +1. When you play this minion, spot another Nazgul to hinder all Free Peoples cards of one type (except companion). The Free Peoples player may restore any number of their cards, and must exert one of their characters for each card restored.
lo: "From a mouth unseen there came a deadly laughter."

gt: Enduring. Fierce. Assignment: Return another Winged Nazgul to hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lo: "To the air he had returned, summoning his steed ere the darkness failed, and now he was come again, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death."

gt: The Shadow player may hinder any of their own support cards. Spot an unhindered Shadow support card.  Make a [rohan] companion strength +1 for each of the following: that card's twilight cost, cards stacked on that card, culture tokens on that card, copies of that card you can spot.

Beacon. To play, hinder 4 beacons. This cannot be discarded or hindered. Your [GONDOR] Men are considered [ROHAN] Men. Your [ROHAN] Men are considered [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: Hinder X beacons to play X items from your discard pile on your Men.
lo: "And so King Théoden departed from his own realm, and mile by mile the long road wound away..."

gt: Exert a skirmishing valiant companion twice (or spot Eowyn in a skirmish) to make a minion strength -1 for each hindered or wounded card you can spot.
lo: "'You look upon a woman. Éowyn I am, Éomund's daughter. You stand between me and my lord and kin. Begone, if you be not deathless! For living or dark undead, I will smite you, if you touch him.'"

gt: Valiant. Enduring. While you can spot 3 [ROHAN] companions (or Eowyn), Merry is considered a [ROHAN] Man. Each time another [ROHAN] Man exerts, you may exert Merry to heal that Man. Skirmish: If he is not assigned to a skirmish, hinder Merry to immediately resolve a skirmish involving a [ROHAN] Man.
Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Maneuver: Hinder this beacon and exert an unbound Man.  Until the regroup phase, each of your other Men gain each of the unloaded keywords on that Man.
lo: "'It is over-late to send for aid when you are already besieged,' answered Beregond. 'But I do not know the counsel of the Lord and his captains.'"

gt: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Each time you play a mount on your Man, you may add (1) to heal that Man. Response: If a mount borne by your Man exerts a minion, hinder a beacon to exert that minion again.
lo: "'And there, I think, he will hear tidings of war, and the Riders of Rohan will go down to Minas Tirith.'"

gt: Bearer must be Theoden. [Rohan] companions are strength +1 (or +2 if mounted) for each wound on Theoden. At the start of the assignment phase, the Shadow player may exhaust a minion of strength 15 or more to hinder Snowmane.
lo: "Lightfoot's foal, swift Snowmane."

gt: Exert Theoden or Eomer to wound a mounted minion twice.  You may then exert X [rohan] companions to discard X stacked Shadow cards.
lo: "He let blow the horns to rally all men to his banner that could come thither; for he thought to make a great shield-wall at the last, and stand, and fight there on foot till all fell..."

gt: Play up to 2 pipes from your draw deck.  If you cannot spot Theoden, add a burden for each pipe played.
lo: "'Live now in blessedness; and when you sit in peace with your pipe, think of me! For never now shall I sit with you in Meduseld, as I promised, or listen to your herb-lore.'"

gt: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] companion. While bearer is mounted, bearer is strength +1 and each time bearer wins a skirmish, you must exert them to wound a minion.
lo: "South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil."

gt: To play, spot a [SAURON] card. Each time a companion exerts, draw a card (limit once per site). Response: If a companion is exerted by a Free Peoples card, discard another Cirith Ungol Watcher to add 2 threats and hinder that companion.
Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Skirmish: Exert a Troll twice and hinder this condition to discard a Free Peoples card borne by a companion that Troll is skirmishing.
lo: "'Go now, and die in what way seems best to you.'"

gt: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Response: If a burden is added, hinder an Orc and this condition to add a threat. Response: If a threat is added, hinder an Orc and this condition to add a burden.
lo: "'He is burning, already burning,' he said sadly. 'The house of his spirit crumbles.'"

gt: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Skirmish: Exert an Orc or Troll and hinder a twilight condition to make that minion strength +2.
lo: "The shadows closed on men again, and their hearts went cold, and the valour of Gondor withered into ash."

gt: Twilight. To play, hinder 4 twilight conditions. This cannot be discarded or hindered. Orcs gain fierce. Trolls gain enduring. Nazgul gain damage +1. Your Men and Uruk-hai gain archer. Shadow: Hinder X of your other Shadow support cards to play Sauron from your hand or discard pile; he is twilight cost -X.

Twilight. Each time you play an Orc or Troll, add (1) (limit once per phase). Shadow or Regroup: Remove (2) to choose a Shadow condition from your discard pile. Shuffle it into your draw deck (or you may play it if it is twilight).
lo: "'No...not at sunrise. The Darkness has begun. There will be no dawn.'"

gt: This minion is strength +1 for each hindered card you can spot. Skirmish: Exert this minion to hinder a weapon or condition borne by a companion it is skirmishing.
lo: "Their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places."

gt: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] minion and remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to exert every character sharing a culture with that companion. Hinder this condition.
lo: "It tumbled down, small round shot that did not burn. But when men ran to learn what it might be, they cried aloud or wept."

gt: Sauron is twilight cost -1 for each artifact and companion you can spot (limit -6). While you can spot 6 companions, Sauron is fierce.  While you can spot 7 companions, Sauron is relentless (he participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce.). Each time a companion loses a skirmish to Sauron, kill that companion.
Exert 3 [sauron] minions (or spot Sauron) to hinder all Free Peoples support cards.  For each card hindered, hinder a Shadow support card.
lo: "Victory was slipping from his grasp even as he stretched out his hand to seize it. But his arm was long. He was still in command, wielding great powers."

gt: Lurker. Each time a companion loses a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must add a threat or a burden. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a wounded companion strength -1.
lo: "Those nearby saw the anguish in his face, and now he seemed...crushed, defeated at last."

t: They Are Not All Accounted For
gt: To play, spot 2 [sauron] or [ringwraith] cards. Each time a Free Peoples card reveals or discards a card from any draw deck, you may exert an unbound companion or ally to draw a card (limit once per site).
lo: "'Fëanor himself, maybe, wrought them, in days so long ago...But there is nothing that Sauron cannot turn to evil uses.'"

gt: Exert a unique [sauron] or [ringwraith] minion and hinder the Ring-bearer to make each minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lo: "'And now he shall endure the slow torment of years, as long and slow as our arts in the Great Tower can contrive, and never be released, unless maybe when he is changed and broken...'"

t: Driven By Her Own Cruel Will
gt: Make a skirmishing Hobbit bearing a hand weapon (except the Ring-bearer) strength +X, where X is the total vitality of all characters in that skirmish.  At the end of that skirmish, hinder a minion involved in that skirmish if you cannot spot more than 4 companions.
lo: "'You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay!'"

gt: Pipeweed. Bearer must bear a pipe. When you play this possession, you may shuffle up to 2 pipes or pipeweed from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lo: "'We have heaps of it,' he said; 'and you can all pack as much as you wish, when we go.'"

gt: Exert a unique [gondor] or [shire] companion (except Frodo) to make that companion strength +1 for each burden on Frodo (limit +3 unless you cannot spot more than 4 companions).  Remove this from the game.
lo: "'His Eye is now straining towards us, blind almost to all else that is moving....Therein lies all our hope.'"

gt: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer). In region 1, hinder all other Hobbits. In region 2, make that Hobbit defender +2 until the regroup phase. In region 3, make that Hobbit enduring until the regroup phase.

Spot a Hobbit skirmishing more than 1 minion to resolve skirmishes between that Hobbit and those minions individually.  Until the regroup phase, add a burden each time that Hobbit loses a skirmish and a threat each time that Hobbit wins.
lo: "The orc wheeled round, but before it could make a move Sam slashed its whip-hand from its arm."

gt: Ring-bearer (resistance 7).  Ring-bound. Frodo is strength +1 for each burden.
lo: "'Look here, Sam dear lad,' said Frodo: 'I am tired, weary, I haven't a hope left. But I have to go on trying to get to the Mountain, as long as I can move. The Ring is enough. This extra weight is killing me. It must go.'"

gt: Spot Frodo to restore a [shire] card.  If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, you may add (3) to reconcile your hand and heal up to 2 [shire] companions.
lo: "'I'll get there, if I leave everything but my bones behind,' said Sam. 'And I'll carry Mr. Frodo up myself, if it breaks my back and heart.'"

gt: Pipeweed. When you play this, you may discard a Free Peoples card from your draw deck. When you discard this with a pipe, you may spot another Hornblower Barrel to take 2 other Free Peoples cards (except events or Hornblower Barrels) from your discard pile into hand.
Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Each time a pipeweed is discarded, you may exert bearer to play that pipeweed from your discard pile.  Hinder it and this pipe.
lo: "'But Ents only drink, and drink is not enough for content. Treebeard's draughts may be nourishing, but one feels the need of something solid.'"

gt: Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed to remove X threats, where X is the number of pipes you can spot. Hinder this pipe or hinder bearer.
lo: "'I have carried it a long way, though I don't know why. I never really expected to find any pipe-weed on the journey, when my own ran out.'"

gt: Ring-bound. Frodo is resistance +2.Maneuver: If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, add a burden to choose condition or possession, then choose odd or even.  Hinder all Shadow support cards with a type and twilight cost matching your choice. Limit once per turn.
lo: "'I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you...!'"

gt: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Assignment: If you cannot spot a companion with a culture other than [shire], exert Smeagol and hinder him to spot a minion.  Add (2) (and add 2 threats if that minion is twilight cost 5 or more) to hinder that minion.
lo: "...thought that they beheld an old weary hobbit..."

gt: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Skirmish: If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, add a threat to make bearer strength +1 for each threat you can spot (limit +6). Response: If The One Ring is transferred, play this on the new Ring-bearer. You may use this ability from your discard pile.
lo: "Sting flashed out...but at its edges a blue fire flicked."

t: The Sooner We're Rid of It
gt: To play, spot 2 Hobbit companions. Skirmish: Exert a companion and hinder each card borne by them to make that companion strength +1 for each card hindered (+3 if that card is a weapon).  Hinder this condition (or discard this if you can spot more than 4 companions).
To play, spot a pipe or an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be a companion. Fellowship: Discard 2 pipeweeds and spot X pipes to make X companions strength +1 until the regroup phase. Hinder this pipe.
lo: "'I keep a treasure or two near my skin, as precious as Rings to me. Here's one: my old wooden pipe.'"

gt: To play, spot a Hobbit companion. Make the Shadow player exhaust 1 of your characters.  For each exertion made, hinder a Shadow support card.  If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, you may make the Shadow player shuffle one of their hindered cards (and all cards stacked on it) into their owner's draw deck.
Fellowship: Exert an unbound Hobbit to play a pipe and pipeweed from your draw deck (limit once per phase).
At the start of each phase, the Shadow player may remove (1) to take a Shadow event for that phase into hand from discard.
At the start of the maneuver phase, hinder all weapons. All characters gain enduring.
When moving here, for each Free Peoples card borne by companions, the Free Peoples player must discard it or add (1).
Battleground. Each minion is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
Mountain. Underground. Game text on Free Peoples items and The One Ring does not apply. Each minion is strength +1.
Mountain. Underground. Battleground. Each time a card is hindered, discard it.  Each time a character is exerted, wound it.
Mountain. Battleground. Each time a threat is added, the Free Peoples player must assign all threat wounds.
Mountain. At the start of each phase, the Shadow player may remove (1) to hinder a card (except companions or The One Ring).
Mountain. Shadow: Remove a burden or a threat to play a minion from your discard pile. If it costs (5) or more, add (1).
